metadata.title: Brave : A Warrior's Tale (USA)
metadata.description: 70 years after the first Brave game on PS2, the Indian tells his first adventures to the younger generation. The remake Brave: A Warrior's Tale on Xbox 360 is thus experienced in the manner of a flashback. This action/adventure game has us follow the young Indian in his quest to find Dancing Spirit, the only warrior capable of helping him save his village. The animals will lend a hand to the hero by helping him with some special powers.

metadata.title: Brian Lara International Cricket 2007 (Europe)
metadata.description: Brian Lara International Cricket 2007 is a sports game for Xbox 360. The title allows you to compete against the best cricketers in the world. Numerous tournaments and championships await you: the ICC World Cup 2007 and the ICC Champions Trophy 2006. These competitions are supported by various points, ranking and communication systems.

metadata.title: Brink (Asia)(En,Fr,Es)
metadata.description: BRINK is an essentially multiplayer FPS available on Xbox 360. The action takes place on the Ark, an artificial archipelago that has taken in thousands of climate refugees who have fled the rising waters. You play as either a representative of the authorities or a revolutionary who intends to overthrow the autocratic power. You will be able to take on the role of four different character classes in order to achieve the different objectives assigned to you.

metadata.title: Brothers in Arms : Hell's Highway (Germany)
metadata.description: Brothers in Arms: Hell's Highway on Xbox 360 is the third installment in the series. A first-person shooter, the title plunges you into the middle of World War II, in the shoes of an American soldier ready to do anything to stop the German invasion. Many new missions are on the agenda, and Sergeant Matt Baker and his men of the 101st Airborne are waiting for you to help them in their task.

variants.name: Brothers in Arms - Hell's Highway (USA, Europe) (En,Fr,Es,It).zip

metadata.title: Brunswick Pro Bowling (Europe)
metadata.description: Brunswick Pro Bowling on Xbox 360 is, as the name suggests, a bowling game. Become the king of the strike with this title where every parameter of the ball must be taken into account to win. Control the trajectory, orientation, speed and rotation of the ball to make the scores explode.

metadata.title: Brütal Legend (Europe)(En,De,It)
metadata.description: Brütal Legend on Xbox 360 is a beat'em all in which you play as a roadie named Eddie Riggs, a trashy rocker. Dive into a dreamlike world with omnipresent humour and a heavy metal atmosphere in the background. Armed with Separator, a two-bladed axe, and Clementine, his trusty guitar, get ready to take on Emperor Doviculus and his army of demons.

metadata.title: Bullet Soul - Infinite Burst
metadata.description: Bullet Soul Infinite Burst is a vertically scrolling shooting game crossing old-school gameplay with a bullet hell twist. It adds numerous gameplay enhancements over its predecessor, Bullet Soul, not least of which is Burst Mode. The same aggressive, bullet-cancelling gameplay, now with more destruction, more coins and more tunes. Shooting fans, it's time to welcome back the true Japanese shooting experience!

metadata.title: Bullet Witch (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Bullet Witch is an action-adventure game for Xbox 360. Alicia, the Bullet Witch, is the only one able to save what remains of humanity from a demonic invasion. In 2013, after many humans have already succumbed to cataclysms, hordes of hellish creatures descend on Earth. Alicia, a witch by trade, must face these enemies to ensure the planet's survival.

metadata.title: Bulletstorm (Germany)(En,De)
metadata.description: Bulletstorm is a first-person shooter for Xbox 360. Based in a futuristic utopian universe, the game follows Grayson Hunt and Ishi Sato, two members of a paramilitary organisation working for a futuristic confederation called Dead Echo. But the duo will end up on the planet Stygia, home to dangerous mutants.

metadata.title: Bully
metadata.description: As a mischievous schoolboy, you’ll stand up to bullies, get picked on by teachers, play pranks, win or lose the girl, and ultimately learn to navigate the obstacles of the worst school around, Bullworth Academy - a corrupt and crumbling prep school with an uptight facade.

metadata.title: Bully : Scholarship Edition (Asia)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Bully: Scholarship Edition for Xbox 360 is a third-person action game that takes you to Bullworth Academy, a public school in New England. You play as Jimmy Hopkins, a 15 year old boy who is a real misfit and will do anything to live up to his reputation as a bully. With main missions, side challenges and mini-games, Bully offers the player a busy schedule.

metadata.title: Bureau : XCOM Declassified, The (Germany)
metadata.description: The Bureau: XCOM Declassified is a tactical TPS for Xbox 360. It tells the story of the mysterious beginnings of XCOM, a para-governmental organisation that was supposed to face a communist invasion. As Special Agent William Carter, the player must take command and lead his teams of agents in a war against not the communists, but the aliens who have invaded the planet.

metadata.title: Burnout Paradise (Japan, Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Burnout Paradise proves that crashing is awesome! Next generation technology has enabled an unprecedented level of crash deformation allowing you to experience the most explosive pile-ups in the series' history. Now the development team can realize their original vision for the Burnout franchise: an open world environment where you can do anything, anywhere, anytime. Feel the adrenaline course through your veins as you take to the road for the first time in Paradise City, where the action is all around you. Explore the city, discover events, and look for the best opportunities to crash, jump and pull signature takedowns. In Burnout Paradise you're given the keys to the city, but it's up to you to earn the keys to the meanest and most dangerous cars on the street, and earn your Burnout license.

metadata.title: Burnout : Revenge (Asia)
metadata.description: Burnout Revenge on Xbox 360 awakens the road monster in you! In this nervous racing game, you are encouraged to break all the basic rules of the road. Sending opponents into the scenery, driving the wrong way, taking improbable shortcuts, everything is good to get the victory. The driving will be drunk or not!

metadata.title: Cabela's African Adventures (USA)
metadata.description: Cabela's continues its long-running series of hunting games. Players explore vast open-world environments and attempt to track down the biggest and most dangerous animals the continent has to offer in Cabela's African Adventures. Players can freely explore five different biomes on foot or in vehicles. A variety of different firearms and hunting tools are available to track and kill rhinos, lions, elephants and other wild beasts.

metadata.title: Cabela's African Safari
metadata.description: Players discover Africa's untamed wild as they hunt a variety of African big game in pursuit of the ultimate hunting challenge - the feared Big Five - leopards, lions, elephants, rhinos and Cape buffalo. In Cabela's African Safari, players choose from seven, 10 or 14 day safaris including open safari, game tracking, baiting and herd hunting missions. The game features over 30 exotic species of animals including sable, kudu, gemsbok, eland, waterbuck, and impala.

metadata.title: Cabela's Alaskan Adventures (Europe)
metadata.description: Cabela's Alaskan Adventures on Xbox 360 is a hunting game that is more arcade oriented than simulation. The player wanders through the arid territories of Alaska in search of his prey. White bear, elk but also fishing parties are on the program of the title. Beware, the prey can sometimes become the hunter...

metadata.title: Cabela's Big Game Hunter 2010 (USA)
metadata.description: Cabela's Big Game Hunter 2010 is a first-person shooter for Xbox 360. The player takes on the role of a hunter whose goal is very simple: to hunt any type of animal... even protected species. With its sumptuous scenery and ultra-realistic handling of its weapons, the game will be a real treat for all budding hunters.

metadata.title: Cabela's Dangerous Hunts 2009 (USA)
metadata.description: Cabela's Dangerous Hunts 2009 is a hunting game for Xbox 360. Go into the forest with a rifle or two, an equally powerful handgun, bait, bear collars, tranquilizer darts and camouflage your scent to flush out your prey. Many dangerous animals will be used to complete your kill list, but you'll need to be patient to find them and take them down.

metadata.title: Cabela's Dangerous Hunts 2011 (Europe)
metadata.description: Cabela's Dangerous Hunts 2011 is a hunting simulation for Xbox 360. As a young hunter, the player will have to accompany his father in wild environments (American mountains, African savannah...) all around the world to prove his worth by killing various game. Multiplayer events are also available in a separate game mode.

metadata.title: Cabela's Outdoor Adventures (USA)
metadata.description: Cabela's Outdoor Adventures is a hunting and fishing simulation for Xbox 360. You play as a hunter travelling the United States in search of trophies. Your ultimate goal will be to appear in Outdoor, a specialized magazine. You will also have to master the terrain, find the best approach point etc. Hunting and fishing are not easy sports.

metadata.title: Cabela's Survival : Shadows of Katmai (USA)
metadata.description: Cabela's Survival: Shadow of Katmai is a hunting simulation for Xbox 360. The player plays as Logan James, isolated in Alaska after his plane crashes. He has to survive in environments whose hostility is matched only by that of the many predators in the region.

metadata.title: Cabela's Trophy Bucks
metadata.description: Experience fast paced hunting action in pursuit of record trophy bucks across 24 state and provinces in North America. Gameplay starts at the most critical and exciting parts of each hunting mission where you are immediately presented with a challenge. Paired with incredibly realistic gameplay and North America's most popular deer, waterfowl, upland birds, small game and varmint species, you will be able to hunt for animals in places that most hunters could only dream of experiencing in a lifetime. Your well-honed hunting instinct, keen observation and quick decision making will be essential in your quest to become the ultimate North American hunter!

metadata.title: Call of Duty : Modern Warfare 2 (France)(Demo)
metadata.description: The game's campaign follows Task Force 141, a multi-national special forces unit commanded by Captain Soap MacTavish as they hunt Vladimir Makarov, leader of the Russian Ultranationalist party, and U.S. Army Rangers from 1st Battalion/75th Ranger Regiment who are defending the Washington, D.C. area from a Russian invasion. The game's main playable characters are Sergeant Gary "Roach" Sanderson, of the 141, and Private James Ramirez, of the Army Rangers, with Captain MacTavish becoming playable later in the campaign. An expansive multiplayer mode is featured in the game, with several new features and modes that were not seen in its predecessor.

metadata.title: Call Of Duty 2 (Germany)
metadata.description: The game is set during World War II and the campaign mode is experienced through the perspectives of four soldiers: one in the Red Army, one in the United States Army, and two in the British Army. It contains four individual campaigns, split into three stories, with a total of 27 missions. Many features were added and changed from the original Call of Duty, notably regenerating health and an icon that indicates a nearby grenade about to explode.

metadata.title: Call of Duty 3 : En Marche vers Paris (Europe)(Fr,Es,It)
metadata.description: The single player is modeled after the Normandy breakout, where the British, Canadian, Polish, American and French Resistance forces pushed into the village of Chambois, France, also known as the Falaise Gap. Unlike most other games in the Call of Duty series, the events in Call of Duty 3 are based on a single combined campaign, with the player being switched between the four nations and their respective characters for each leg of the story. There are 14 campaign missions.

metadata.title: Call of Duty 4 : Modern Warfare (Germany)
metadata.description: The story takes place in the year of 2011, where a radical leader has executed the president of an unnamed country in the Middle East, and an ultranationalist movement ignites a civil war in Russia. The conflicts are seen from the perspectives of a U.S. Marine Force Recon sergeant and a British SAS commando and are set in various locales, such as the United Kingdom, the Middle East, Azerbaijan, Russia, and Ukraine. The multiplayer portion of the game features various game modes and contains a leveling system that allows the player to unlock additional weapons, weapon attachments, and camouflage schemes as they advance.

metadata.title: Carnival Games - Monkey See, Monkey Do (Taiwan)
metadata.description:
Get ready for a dip in the Shark Tank, a raucous ride on Coin Coaster Mountain or a Cotton-Eyed Joe dance-off with the Monkey Barker. Carnival Games:Monkey See, Monkey Do was made specifically to take full advantage of the innovative Kinect technology, offering easy access to all the thrills and fun of Carnival Games. Corner to Whirligig Way -- set the stage for gamers to swing away in the batting cage, avoid twisting tornadoes in the Hot Air Balloon Race, take a galactic journey to the red planet in Rocket to Mars and much more.

Classic games like Alley Ball, Milk Bottle Throw and Wheel of Chance add to the family fun. All manner of interactive prizes and surprises abound, including pet dragons, robot cowboys, flying bears and ninja masks.

In addition, Kinect for Xbox 360's voice recognition technology allows The Amazing Wodin, a wily wizard with a weakness for wit, to advise players of their future. Also making his debut appearance in a Carnival Games title, is the Monkey Barker. Smartly dressed and renowned for his dancing skills, he promises to bring a fair share of monkey mischief to the midway.

If only there was a way to get all your favorite cartoon characters together... Well you don't have to wait any longer... Get ready for a Punch Time Explosion!

metadata.title: Castlevania : Lords of Shadow (Japan)(Disc 1)
metadata.description: Gabriel Belmont is a member of the Brotherhood of Light, a group of holy knights who serve to protect the innocent from the forces of evil. His wife Marie, recently murdered by the same evil, now lies trapped between the Earth and the Heavens. Her soul along with many others is neither living nor dead. Gabriel finds out that the Lords of Shadow are behind everything, and that they possess an item known as the God Mask that could bring his beloved Marie back from the dead. Together with Zobek, another member of the Brotherhood, he sets out across the ruined landscapes of Earth; filled with everything from werewolves, vampires, and undead beings, to end the Lords of Shadow destruction. Gabriel vows to do everything in his power to get his Marie back, even at the cost of falling into the darkness he seeks to destroy.

metadata.title: Castlevania : Lords of Shadow 2 (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt)
metadata.description:
One thousand years after his victory over the Lords of Shadow and Satan himself, at the cost of his own humanity, Dracula is visited by his old "friend" Zobek, bringing dire news. Satan is about to return, and only Dracula can stop him and his minions from destroying the world. If he succeeds, Zobek promises to free him from the curse of immortality. But before Dracula can take the fight to Satan's acolytes, he will have to recover his old powers.
As its predecessor, Lords of Shadow 2 combines exploration of 3D environments, melee combat and platforming sequences. Instead of a linear succession of levels, however, Lords of Shadow 2 offers a semi-open structure, more similar in spirit to Symphony of the Night. The game alternates between sequences set in modern-day Wygol City, as Dracula tries to undermine the efforts of Satan's acolytes, and dreamlike visits to Dracula's castle.

metadata.title: Catherine (Europe)
metadata.description: Catherine is a puzzle game for Xbox 360. The title is aimed at a mature audience and has as its hero Vincent, an indecisive thirty-something who plays both sides of the fence: Katherine his girlfriend and Catherine his lover. In addition to his love affairs, he finds himself confronted with creatures that haunt his dreams. The moral choices you make will affect the course of the story.

Defend your reputation in Career mode or take part in single or obstacle races, alone or with others online.

metadata.title: Champion Jockey - Gallop Racer & GI Jockey
metadata.description:
"Champion Jockey: G1 Jockey & Gallop Racer" is the newest horse racing simulation title from Koei-Tecmo. While not the first title to do so, the game combines creative input from the Tecmo and Koei development teams. The producer notes that the development team wants to present a "refreshing and real" game. Therefore, members of the team traveled globally to visit horse racing tracks in Europe. Japan's Nakayama Race Track, for instance, will be recreated as close as possible in the game.

As the title suggests, players can enjoy traits found in either racing series. Gallop Racer stands as the Tecmo side while G1 Jockey forms the Koei side. Curiously, the naming for the intellectual properties are switched for the Japanese version, the title instead being "Champion Jockey: Gallop Racer & GI Jockey".

metadata.description: Championship Manager 2007 allows you to manage your club to glory, dealing with everything from tactics and training to transfers - everything you would expect a real-life football manager to do without owning a sheepskin coat.

metadata.title: Chaos;Head Love Chu Chu!
metadata.description: Chaos;Head Love Chu Chu! is a romantic comedy visual novel developed and produced by 5pb. and Nitroplus. The game is described by the development team as a "exploding delusions ADV" and belongs to the Science Adventure series. Like in Chaos;Head, the player assumes the role of Takumi Nishijo.

metadata.title: Chaos Head Noah (Japan)
metadata.description: Chaos Head Noah on Xbox 360 is a seduction game that requires little interaction from the player. The player only needs to read and click on the text to progress through the game. You have to investigate a serial killer with a group of heroines who will be generous with you during the dialogue phases.

metadata.title: Chaotic : Shadow Warriors (USA)
metadata.description: Chaotic: Shadow Warriors on Xbox 360 is the adaptation of the eponymous card game and the spin-off TV series. The title has a game system that mixes card games, role-playing games and strategy in a Heroic-Fantasy universe. Chaotic: Shadow Warriors allows you to fight creatures using the equipment and spells available.

metadata.title: Chikyuu Boueigun 3
metadata.description:
An arcade style TPS, which in 53 levels, pits you against giant ants, giant spiders, giant robots and UFOs. Luckily for you, the game has an arsenal of over 150 different weapons and 4 different vehicles, all collectible throughout the game. And don't forget, every building is destructible! And how.

The Xbox 360 version features 2-player split-screen multiplayer where you can play cooperative or versus battle.

metadata.title: Child Of Eden (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: Child of Eden is a shoot'em up for Xbox 360. Five thematically different levels are offered, and you can use a machine gun, guided missiles or bombs to eliminate the viruses infesting the memory of a gigantic computer program. The game is played from a first-person perspective and relies on speed, colour and music.

metadata.title: Chrome Hounds (Japan)
metadata.description: Do giant, flashy robots make you drool all over the floor? Welcome to the world of Chrome Hounds. This action game for Xbox 360 puts you in command of gigantic mechas (called Hounds here) in six distinct campaigns in a dark futuristic conflict. Each campaign has a specific Hound. From the Sniper to the Defender and the assault model, enter a world of gleaming brutes!

metadata.title: Crash Of The Titans (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)

This episode of Crash Bandicoot features a massive change in aesthetics and gameplay. The characters have undergone their biggest facelift yet. The gameplay, while still platform-focused, features more combat, allowing Crash to punch and kick enemies, ... The gameplay also focuses on controlling Titans, giant mutants that are far more powerful than Crash himself. They can be controlled by Crash by riding them.
The game's story centres on the discovery of a substance called Mojo, which Doctor Neo Cortex intends to use to transform the inhabitants of Wumpa Island into an army of loyal mutants known as "Titans". Crash must stop Cortex using the "overlap" technique to take control of them and destroy Cortex's Titans while collecting the mojo.

Here you are in the middle of arenas filled with guys determined to stop you from advancing. Chain together deaths to boost your score before you can proudly display it online. A multiplayer mode also allows you to compete with friends online.

metadata.title: Crash Time III (Europe)(En,De)
metadata.description: Crash Time III is a racing game for Xbox 360 inspired by the TV series Cobra Alert. This title puts you at the wheel of the famous German sedans in which you have to carry out various missions such as searching for clues through the city, chases etc. In total, there are 200 km of tracks in the game.

metadata.title: Code_18
metadata.description:
Code_18 is the fifth entry in the Infinity series, which also includes Never 7: The End of Infinity, Ever 17: The Out of Infinity, Remember 11: The Age of Infinity, and 12Riven: The Psi-Climinal of Integral. The game follows Hayato Hino, a high school student who receives voice messages from the future on his phone, and is stuck in a loop, repeating a month of his life over and over again.

Cyberfront bought the rights to the Infinity series after its previous developer, KID, closed down. The game's writing was done by the group Run & Gun, while the sound production was handled by the band Milktub. While the development team had originally planned to use a theme of "escape from an enclosed space" similarly to previous Infinity games, it was changed due to concerns of the size of the game's audience, and was seen as a reboot of the series.

metadata.title: College Hoops 2k6 (USA)
metadata.description: College Hoops 2K6 is a basketball game for Xbox 360 that lets you experience the college level competition where young talent fights for the top pick in the NBA draft. Participate in many championship games that will focus on the personality of your players. It's up to you to create a stable team according to very precise selection criteria.

metadata.title: Command & Conquer - Red Alert 3
metadata.description: Command & Conquer: Red Alert 3 is set in an alternate reality from World War II, in which the Western Allies fought the Soviet Union. In Red Alert 3 the Soviet leadership, facing defeat, goes back in time to kill Albert Einstein and prevent his assistance to the allies, paving the way for Soviet domination in the present. However, as an unintended consequence, a third world power, the Empire of the Rising Sun, is created and all three sides go to war.

metadata.title: Command & Conquer 3 : La Fureur de Kane (USA)
metadata.description: Kane's Fury is a real-time strategy game for Xbox 360. The events of the single-player campaign take place before Command & Conquer 3: The Tiberium Wars, placing the player at the head of a bloodless NOD brotherhood seeking revenge. The game also introduces six new sub-factions.

metadata.title: Command and Conquer 3 : Tiberium Wars (Europe)
metadata.description: Command & Conquer 3 is a strategy game for Xbox 360. Command the NOD or the GDI and fight your enemy to establish your army on earth. Build your bases, your men and your weapons to defeat your opponents. Playable in LAN and online multiplayer, C&C 3 has many surprises in store, such as the possibility of managing a new alien faction, the Scrins...

metadata.title: Conan (Germany)
metadata.description: Conan sur Xbox 360 est un jeu d'action/aventure épique et brutal qui se déroule sur fond de lutte contre le mal dans un cadre fantastique. Suivez l'aventure de Conan le Cimmérien, amené à se battre contre de nombreux ennemis et contre un mal insaisissable qui menace de détruire le monde. Utilisant tout ce qu'il y a sous votre main, des armes redoutables aux éléments du décor, vous pouvez tout détruire sur votre passage dans les différents royaumes du monde Hyborien.

metadata.title: Condemned (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: A long dark corridor, barely lit by an almost suppurating light. Where the hell is that junkie? And then a scream... Welcome to the sordid world of Condemned on Xbox 360, a first-person shooter. Well, shooting... when you have ammunition. Because in this dark and gloomy universe, it's mostly with bladed weapons that you make your way, getting deeper and deeper into a horror with not always very human features...

metadata.title: Condemned 2 : Bloodshot (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,Es,It)
metadata.description: A former agent specialising in tracking down serial killers, Ethan Thomas must once again plunge into madness in Condemned 2 for Xbox 360, a title that features hand-to-hand combat in a dark and unhealthy world.

metadata.title: Conflict : Denied Ops (Germany)
metadata.description: The story takes place in a fictional war in Venezuela. General Ramírez and his associates have staged the Ramírez regime where Ramírez is slowly plotting to take over his country. First he sends his troops to seize the Petro Nivera oil refinery, then threatens to deploy nuclear weapons if the United States continue to "meddle in his country's affairs". The US government sends two CIA operatives, Lincoln Graves and Reggie Lang, on a series of missions to take down General Ramírez and any other possible threat. First the two operatives are sent to the ruins of the Santa Cecilia monastery to retrieve important data on Ramírez's connections and associates. After extracting via their commander, they encounter a number of different conflicts all seemingly connected to Ramírez. Eventually they track down Ramírez and end up arresting him.

metadata.description: America\'s hottest country music stars are headed to your living room for a brand new interactive dance experience with bonus sing-a-long features that\'s packed with dozens of hits from your favorite country chart-toppers! Country Dance All Stars features more than 35 tracks from the best names in country music.

metadata.title: Crackdown ~ Riot Act
metadata.description:
Crackdown is an open world, third-person shooter video game for the Xbox 360. Set in the fictional Pacific City, the player controls a biologically enhanced Agent, tasked with defeating three crime lords and their organized crime syndicates. The Agent's abilities improve by defeating both crime lords and their supporters, as well as by completing optional activities, such as street races and scavenger hunts. The gameplay is nonlinear: instead of following a rigid mission sequence, players are free to select the approach to completing their missions and activities. The game features a two-player cooperative play mode via Xbox Live.
Crackdown, initially planned for release on the original Xbox console, was envisioned as a vast world in which players could experiment and explore freely. Microsoft Game Studios bundled specifically marked copies of Crackdown with an access code to the multiplayer test version of the much-anticipated Halo 3 Beta. The game sold 1.5 million copies in its first six months of release because everybody wanted to play Halo 3. It received positive reviews and has garnered several awards for its innovative gameplay. Crackdown was a free download (for Xbox Live Gold members only) from August 1st, 2013 to August 16th, 2013 as part of the Xbox 360 "Games With Gold" (Xbox Live) program.

metadata.title: Crackdown 2 ~ Riot Act 2
metadata.description: Crackdown 2 is a sandbox-style third-person shooter video game developed by Ruffian Games and published by Microsoft Game Studios. It was released on Xbox 360 in July 2010 and is a direct sequel to the 2007 video game Crackdown.

metadata.title: Crash - Mind over Mutant
metadata.description: Crash: Mind Over Mutant is the sequel to Crash of the Titans and the seventh Crash Bandicoot series game. The game uses many of the same mechanics as its predecessor with a few changes. Rather than having twenty linear platforming levels to complete in sequence, Mind Over Mutant features eight distinct locations for Crash to explore and travel between as the story progresses. The player can complete missions given by non-playable characters and discover collectibles through the levels.

metadata.title: Crash Of The Titans (USA)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl)
metadata.description:
This episode of Crash Bandicoot features a massive change in aesthetics and gameplay. The characters have undergone their biggest facelift yet. The gameplay, while still platform-focused, features more combat, allowing Crash to punch and kick enemies, ... The gameplay also focuses on controlling Titans, giant mutants that are far more powerful than Crash himself. They can be controlled by Crash by riding them.
The game's story centres on the discovery of a substance called Mojo, which Doctor Neo Cortex intends to use to transform the inhabitants of Wumpa Island into an army of loyal mutants known as "Titans". Crash must stop Cortex using the "overlap" technique to take control of them and destroy Cortex's Titans while collecting the mojo.

metadata.title: Crash Time (USA)(En,Fr,De)
metadata.description: An arcade racing game, Crash Time on Xbox 360 immerses us in German car chases, inspired by the Cobra Alert series. The progression follows a succession of missions that often require you to arrest suspects at the controls of the powerful cars of the motorway brigade.

metadata.title: Crash Time 4 : The Syndicate (Europe)(En,Fr,De)
metadata.description: Crash Time IV on Xbox 360 is a game of chases between good and evil (the police and the Syndicate) that allows you to drive sports cars, trucks, utility vehicles or tanks, both in single and multiplayer. This mode allows up to 8 players to compete simultaneously.

metadata.title: Crash Time 5 : Undercover (Europe)(En,De)
metadata.description: Crash Time 5: Undercover for Xbox 360 is a racing game inspired by the Cobra Alert series. Alternate between playing as a police officer or a gangster during frantic races to infiltrate the gang, collect clues and put an end to the road criminals!

metadata.title: Crash Time II (Europe)(En,Fr,De)
metadata.description: Crash Time II on Xbox 360 is directly inspired by the Cobra Alert series. You play as one of the two cops of the shock duo and must complete as many missions as possible, sometimes on German motorways, sometimes in the city. At the wheel of big German sedans, the player alternates between checkpoint races, patrols and car chases. The game includes a multiplayer mode where four users can compete in split screen mode.

metadata.title: Crash Time III (Europe)(En,Fr,De)
metadata.description: Crash Time III is a racing game for Xbox 360 inspired by the TV series Cobra Alert. This title puts you at the wheel of the famous German sedans in which you have to carry out various missions such as searching for clues through the city, chases etc. In total, there are 200 km of tracks in the game.

metadata.title: Create (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: Create on 360 is a highly family-friendly puzzle game. The objective is to imagine and design your own levels, improvise solutions, all to unlock a whole host of rewards. Sharing "scenes" (and posting solutions online at www.create.ea.com) is one of the strengths of Create, which presents itself as a LittleBigPlanet-like game. Paintings, textures, elements and animated objects can be used to create challenges in addition to the hundred or so that are offered at the start.

metadata.title: Crew, The (USA)(Disc 1)
metadata.description: The Crew is a racing game set in an open world environment of a scaled-down version of the United States. Players have the ability to drive from coast to coast with the inclusion of major cities such as Chicago, Detroit, Las Vegas, Los Angeles, Miami and New York, as well as specific locales such as Pikes Peak, the Laguna Seca race track, famous landmarks such as Cape Canaveral, many highways and smaller towns. In the single-player campaign the player controls Alex Taylor. He is a witness to the murder on his brother Datton, the leader of a crew called the 5-10's, but is arrested himself. Five years later he is given the opportunity by the FBI to hunt down his brother's killer Dennis 'Shiv' Jefferson, the gang's leader, as he is deployed to unmask the corrupt FBI agent Coburn who is also involved. He has to join the crew himself and make a name for himself to rise up the ranks.

metadata.title: Crossboard 7 (Europe)
metadata.description: Crossboard 7 on Xbox 360 is a Kinect compatible Hoverboard racing game. The player controls his character by mimicking the correct gestures in front of his screen, both in order to negotiate his trajectory and to perform spectacular tricks.

metadata.title: Crysis 2 (Europe)(De,Tr)
metadata.description: Crysis 2 on Xbox 360 is a first-person shooter developed by Crytek. Supposedly set 3 years after the events of the first installment, the game takes us to New York City, which is in the grip of an alien invasion. In the shoes of the Green Beret, the player must exploit the capabilities of his high-tech suit to survive in this urban jungle where the most formidable enemies are not necessarily those you think.

metadata.title: Crysis 3 (Europe)(Es,It)
metadata.description: Set in 2047, Prophet is on a revenge mission after uncovering the truth behind Cell Corporation's motives for building the quarantined Nanodomes. The citizens were told that the giant citywide structures were resurrected to protect the population and to cleanse these metropolises of the remnants of Ceph forces. In reality, the Nanodomes are CELL's covert attempt at a land and technology grab in their quest for global domination. With Alien Ceph lurking around every corner and human enemies on the attack, nobody is safe in the path of vengeance. Everyone is a target in Prophet's quest for retribution.

metadata.title: Culdcept Saga (Japan)(Title Update-ban)
metadata.description: Culdcept Saga is a strategic role-playing game for Xbox 360. Immerse yourself in a fantasy world where wars have ravaged the world. Your role is to stop these wars using your abilities to control powerful monsters and summon powerful entities through mystical cards. Over 500 cards and summonses are available to unlock for unforgettable battles.

metadata.title: Cursed Crusade, The (Europe)
metadata.description: The action takes place in the ancient world. Two warriors are about to embark on an adventure across Europe amid the clashes and battles of the 4th Crusade. Denz, a Templar, and Esteban, a mercenary, share the same motivation: to purge their souls of a terrible curse that afflicts them both. Embark on a quest spanning 5 chapters and 30 missions that will take you across medieval Europe. Use your demonic vision to increase your abilities at the expense of your humanity. Easy to learn, the graphics engine features over 90 combos, dozens of weapons and a time-counting system.

metadata.title: Damage Inc. Pacific Squadron Wwii (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: Damage Inc. Pacific Squadron WWII is an Xbox 360 air combat simulation set during World War II. Players can experience the famous battles of the Pacific in more than 30 aircraft. The single-player mode consists of 11 campaigns and various online multiplayer modes are available to fight or help other players.

variants.name: Damage Inc. - Pacific Squadron WWII (USA, Europe).zip

metadata.title: Damnation (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Damnation on Xbox 360 is a third-person action game that plunges you into key events in an alternate American history. The player is equipped with a substantial arsenal and acrobatic abilities that allow him to evolve in vertical environments. It is also possible to drive vehicles and motorbikes to carry out the missions of the software. Damnation also features a co-op mode and multiplayer options for up to 8 players.

metadata.title: Dance Central (Japan)
metadata.description: Dance Central is a dance game for Xbox 360 that uses Kinect to recognise your body movements. Get ready to sway to the rhythm of some thirty songs. The playlist includes songs by Lady Gaga, Snoop Dog and Kool & the Gang.

metadata.title: Dance Central 2 (World)
metadata.description: Dance Central 2 is a rhythm game for Xbox 360, using the Kinect device. In this new opus you will have to use not only your body but also your voice to impress your friends. Play in pairs, in cooperation or in competition. And if you feel like it, join one of the 4 groups available to evolve in Career mode.

metadata.title: Dance Central 3 (World)(En,Zh)
metadata.description: Travel through time to learn the best dance crazes from across the ages, including disco moves of the 70s, hip-hop moves from the 80s, and the hottest moves on the dance floor today, all set to songs from artists like Usher, Gloria Gaynor, 50 Cent, TLC, and more. Familiar Dance Central crews and characters return with fresh new looks, and new faces join the dance party to keep the beats rocking with an innovative new party mode for up to eight players.

metadata.title: Dance Dance Revolution (USA)
metadata.description: Dance Dance Revolution is a rhythm game for Xbox 360. It contrasts with the previous opuses of the series by offering more challenge. This time, players have to follow the rhythm of the music using the 8 directional arrows on the dance floor, instead of the previous 4. In addition, no less than 50 songs are available for download on Xbox Live.

metadata.title: Dancing Stage Universe (USA)(En,Fr,Es)
metadata.description: Dancing Stage Universe on Xbox 360 lets you become the king or queen of the dance floor. With a dance floor, you can shake your body to the beat of the greatest DJs' mixes. Download new songs and clips via Xbox Live to continue the fun with your friends.

metadata.title: Dance Dance Revolution Universe 2
metadata.description:
Another in the series of the Dance Dance Revolution games, this one is exclusive to the 360 with new songs ranging from the 1970's, 80's and 90's including contemporary artists' songs.

The standard modes are present (split-screen Multiplayer, Workout)with two new ones: Freestyle that features no arrows and is more of an exhibition type aimed for all ages and skill levels, and Quest Mode where players can create their own character with a variety of customization ranging from clothing and appearances playing in a story-based mode in a series of challenges. Additional costumes can be unlocked through the Quest Mode.

Players can also access new songs through Xbox live and compete head-to-head against players in dancing contests. There are editing options where unique dancing sequences can be transposed onto custom background videos.

metadata.title: Dance Dance Revolution Universe 3
metadata.description: DDR UNIVERSE 3 is the third entry to the UNIVERSE franchise on the U.S. Xbox 360, adding a new DJ mode while revamping its arcade and quest modes.

metadata.title: Dance Evolution (Japan, Europe)
metadata.description: Dance Evolution on Xbox 360 allows us to transform our living room into a dance floor thanks to the Kinect accessory. Directly integrated into the image, the player must reproduce a series of movements represented on the screen by silhouettes or signs. Many styles of music are represented and it is possible to play with two people on the same console.

metadata.title: Dance Evolution (USA)
metadata.description: Dance Evolution on Xbox 360 allows us to transform our living room into a dance floor thanks to the Kinect accessory. Directly integrated into the image, the player must reproduce a series of movements represented on the screen by silhouettes or signs. Many styles of music are represented and it is possible to play with two people on the same console.

metadata.title: Dance Paradise (Europe)
metadata.description: Dance Paradise on Xbox 360 is a dance game played with Kinect. Through 3 game modes, solo or with another player, you have to reproduce the movements represented on the screen through 40 songs of international variety (from 50 Cent to Lady Gaga, through Mika or No Doubt). A mode called Video Box also allows you to watch the clips of the different artists on the disc.

metadata.title: Dancing Stage Universe (Europe)
metadata.description: Dancing Stage Universe on Xbox 360 lets you become the king or queen of the dance floor. With a dance floor, you can shake your body to the beat of the greatest DJs' mixes. Download new songs and clips via Xbox Live to continue the fun with your friends.

metadata.title: Dancing Stage Universe 2 (Europe)
metadata.description: Dancing Stage Universe 2 is a dance game for Xbox 360. It features new gameplay modes such as Free Mode, which allows players to dance without having to follow a predetermined pattern. More than 70 songs make up a repertoire ranging from the 1970s to the present day. Multiplayer is enhanced with new content for download.

metadata.title: Dante's Inferno (Europe)(En,De,It)
metadata.description: A soul taken away. A life of sin. An adventure into the depths of despair. Inspired by the literary classic, Dante's Inferno takes you through the nine circles of Hell on a quest for vengeance and redemption. You are Dante, a veteran of the Crusades, who must save his beloved Beatrice and free her from the clutches of Lucifer. Dive into the depths of Hell, where you must not only face terrifying monsters, but also your own sins, a dark past and your own unforgivable war crimes. Go to Hell.

metadata.title: Dark (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: Dark is an abstract, atmospheric puzzle-platformer that takes place in several very dark environments. The player controls what appears to be a black rhombus with eyes, exploring cavernous areas, and seeking the exit to the next area. Along the way are numerous glowing lights to collect, and often the player must move some object or find a secret in order to continue. The game includes five areas, and takes approximately half an hour to complete.

metadata.title: Dark Souls (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Dark Souls is a brand new dark fantasy RPG designed to completely embrace the concepts of tension in dungeon exploration, fear in encountering enemies, the joy of new discoveries, and a high sense of achievement in progressing. The game is set in a dark fantasy world filled with decadent atmosphere, with a heavy emphasis on player freedom in discovering various tactics and strategies to use in weapon based combat.

metadata.title: Dark Souls II (Japan)
metadata.description: Face the challenge once again in this sequel to the hardcore action RPG. Dark Souls II features a new hero, a new storyline, and an unfamiliar world for players to survive in while delivering its signature brand of unrelenting punishment that players hunger for. Epic battles with gruesome enemies and blood-thirsty bosses await adventurers as they traverse through a devastated world filled with death and despair; only those who are strong willed or cunning can survive this journey to achieve great glory. Players seeking to share their experience will discover a revamped server-based multiplayer mode that puts a distinct Dark Souls II twist on the concept of playing with others.

metadata.title: Dark Void (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: In Dark Void, an action game for Xbox 360, you play as a cargo plane pilot. Unluckily, Will, that's his name, crashes in the Bermuda triangle and finds himself propelled into a parallel dimension: The Void. This place is populated by the Watchers, aliens determined to leave this void to conquer the planet. Our hero must save the Earth by standing in the way of these creatures.

metadata.title: Darkest Of Days (USA)
metadata.description: In the first person action game Darkest of Days for Xbox 360, the player relives the most terrible days of humanity such as the Battle of Antietam (1862, the bloodiest battle of the Civil War) or the eruption of Vesuvius near Pompeii in 79 AD. The aim is to save the lives of key individuals who were not supposed to be involved in these events.

metadata.title: Darkness II, The (Japan, Europe)
metadata.description: Based on the comic book of the same name, The Darkness II is a first-person action game for Xbox 360. You play as Jackie Estacado, a 21 year old mobster, who finds himself one of the hosts of the Darkness, an evil entity infusing him with many powers to enable him to take revenge on his uncle who wants him dead.

metadata.title: Darkness, The (Germany)
metadata.description: Based on the comic book of the same name, The Darkness is a first-person action game for Xbox 360. You play as Jackie Estacado, a 21 year old mobster, who finds himself one of the hosts of the Darkness, an evil entity infusing him with many powers to enable him to take revenge on his uncle who wants him dead. The Darkness feeds off the shadows, so you must be vigilant in destroying all forms of light, as well as annihilating any enemy that gets in your way.

metadata.title: Darksiders (Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Ru)
metadata.description: Penned by legendary comic book artist Joe Madureira (X-Men, Battle Chasers, The Ultimates), Darksiders: Wrath of War is set in a Post-Apocalyptic demon-ravaged world where evil forces have prematurely brought about the end of the time. Originally sent to oversee the destruction of Earth, the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse have been betrayed by their master, stripped of their powers and cast down to Earth. Players take on the role of WAR -- the first of the Four Horsemen -- as he embarks on a brutal quest of vengeance and revenge against the forces that betrayed him with the help of his phantom steed RUIN. Darksiders: Wrath of War features open-world exploration, a deep combat system and a huge arsenal of modern and mythical weapons.

metadata.title: Darksiders II (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl,Pl,Ru)
metadata.description: Darksiders II follows the exploits of DEATH, one of the four horsemen of the Apocalypse, in a weaving tale that runs parallel to the events in the original Darksiders game. This epic journey propels DEATH through various light and dark realms as he tries to redeem his brother WAR, the horseman who was blamed for prematurely starting the Apocalypse in Darksiders.

metadata.title: Darkstar One : Broken Alliance (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De)
metadata.description: DarkStar One: Broken Alliance on Xbox 360 is a space role-playing game that features an open world with 330 systems to explore as a smuggler, mercenary, merchant or pirate. The player's spaceship is fully customisable with numerous engines, weapons and shields.

metadata.title: Dead Island (Japan)
metadata.description: Dead Island feature open world gameplay, played from a first person perspective, with up to four-player co-operative play in a heavily interactive environment. The focus will be on melee combat, incorporating customizable weaponry, vehicular customization/combat, and RPG elements.

metadata.title: Dead Island Riptide (Japan)
metadata.description: Dead Island Riptide is the direct sequel to Dead Island on Xbox 360. You play as survivors who must escape from a zombie-infested island. To do this, you'll have to create makeshift weapons to try and unlock the secret behind a virus while trying to stay alive.

metadata.title: Dead Or Alive 4 (Asia)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Zh,Ko)
metadata.description: Dead or Alive 4 on Xbox 360 is a fighting game that is essentially based on the notion of sequences and counter sequences. On the menu: new characters, tons of outfits to unlock and tons of moves for each fighter... It's going to be a blast!

metadata.title: Dead Or Alive 5 (Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Tecmo Koei's long-running 3D fighting series, known for its fast-paced action and occasionally titillating visuals, returns to gamers with destructible stages, perilous new danger zones, and new critical attacks in Dead or Alive 5. Combat takes a rock-paper-scissors form, with players executing throw-beating strikes, hold-beating throws, and strike-beating holds, with properly deflected attacks resulting in high-damage counters. Landing specific moves leaves opponents in a Critical Stun state, which prevents blocking and can lead to devastating Critical Combos and Power Blows.

metadata.title: Dead Or Alive 5 Ultimate (World)
metadata.description: Dead or Alive 5 Ultimate is a fighting game for Xbox 360. It is a re-release of Dead or Alive 5 with some additions. You will find 5 additional characters: Momiji, Rachel, Ein, Leon and Jacky Bryant. The gameplay has also undergone some readjustments for the occasion and new moves have appeared. The title also includes new tutorials.

metadata.title: Dead or Alive : Xtreme 2 (Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Zh,Ko,Pl)
metadata.description: Friends of the two-piece, good evening! Dead or Alive: Xtreme 2 on Xbox 360 showcases the buxom ladies of the series. Gathered once again on Zack's island, the busty fighters will compete in beach volleyball matches and jet-ski races before offering themselves various trinkets and other sexy accessories. No need to say, it smells like summer.

metadata.title: Dead Rising (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: You play as Frank West, a freelance photo-journalist, and you're on a hunt for the scoop of a lifetime. Following a lead to the town of Willamette, he finds that the town has been practically taken over by zombies. Trying to get away, Frank makes his way to the Willamette shopping mall hoping he can find help there.

metadata.title: Dead Rising 2 : Off the Record (USA, Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,Es,It,Ko)
metadata.description: Dead Rising 2: Off the Record is an action game. It features the hero of the first episode, Frank West, in a reinterpretation of the zombie attack on Fortune City. New enemies, vehicles and especially a new story change the game.

metadata.title: Dead Rising 2 (USA)(En,Fr)(Zombrex Edition Bonus Disc)
metadata.description: Dead Rising 2 on Xbox 360 is a bloody and offbeat beat'em all where you play as one of the few survivors of Fortune City, the city where the events take place. You must help Chuck survive the zombie hordes that haunt the streets with the help of a multitude of items ranging from classic guns to the totally crazy items that made the first opus famous.

metadata.title: Dead Space (Europe)(En,Pl,Ru,Cs,Hu)
metadata.description: Dead Space is a science fiction action horror video game. Players take on the role of Isaac Clarke, controlling him through a third-person perspective. Players navigate the spaceship Ishimura, completing objectives given to Isaac during the narrative, solving physics-based puzzles within the environment, and fighting monsters dubbed Necromorphs. In the vacuum Isaac has a limited air supply, which can be replenished by finding air tanks within the environment. Some areas are subject to zero-G, with both Isaac and specific enemy types able to jump between surfaces; these areas have dedicated puzzles. During exploration of the Ishimura, Isaac finds ammunition, health pickups, and Nodes that are used to both unlock special doors and upgrade weapons and Isaac's suit. At certain points in the ship, Isaac can access a store to buy supplies and ammunition.

metadata.title: Dead Space 2 (Europe)(Disc 1)(Beta)(2010-10-05)
metadata.description: Dead Space 2 is a science fiction survival horror video game set three years after the events of the first game. The game follows protagonist Isaac Clarke's fight against a new Necromorph outbreak on the Sprawl, a space station surrounding a shard of Saturn's largest moon, Titan. Unlike its predecessor, Dead Space 2 has a multiplayer mode, pitting human characters against Necromorphs across the Sprawl.

metadata.title: Dead Space 3 (Europe)(Es,It)(Disc 1)
metadata.description: Dead Space 3 is a space survival-horror on Xbox 360. Supported by Sergeant John Carver, playable by a second person in cooperative mode, Isaac Clarke returns to duty after the crash of his ship on Tau Volantis, an ice planet. In search of Ellie, the adventure features new Necromorphs and, for the first time, humans in a borderline horror adventure.

metadata.title: Dead to Rights : Retribution (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,Es,It)
metadata.description: Dead to Rights: Retribution on Xbox 360 is an action game that takes us into the gloomy alleys of Grant City. As Jack Slate, a determined policeman, the player must use his weapons to rid the area of the many criminals who have taken up residence there. To achieve this, Jack is supported by Shadow, a combat-trained dog that you can control at regular intervals.

metadata.title: Deadliest Catch : Alaskan Storm (USA)
metadata.description: Deadliest Catch: Alaskan Storm is an action game for Xbox 360 inspired by the TV show of the same name, where we are shown fishermen risking their lives to go and find precious crabs that only live in the rough waters of the Bering Sea. You are the captain and it is up to you to steer the boat to its goal, you must also choose your crew carefully to be as efficient as possible.

metadata.title: Deadliest Warrior : Ancient Combat (USA)
metadata.description: Deadliest Warrior: Ancient Combat is an Xbox 360 fighting game that combines Deadliest Warrior: The Game and Deadliest Warrior: Legends on one disc. Experience the best fighters from the greatest civilisations through the ages in a game adapted from a TV show.

metadata.title: Deadly Premonition (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Deadly Premonition on Xbox 360 is a survival horror inspired by Twin Peaks. We play as Francis York Morgan, a young FBI agent, who comes to investigate in the town of Greenvale, a lost and closed town, following a mysterious murder.

metadata.title: Deathsmiles Deluxe Edition (Europe)
metadata.description: Deathsmiles is a horizontal shoot'em up from Cave on Xbox 360. Coming from the Arcade, this title is resolutely zany by involving witches, giant cows and other original creatures.

metadata.description: Deathsmiles II is a shooting game for Xbox 360 in which you can play as young ladies shooting anything that moves on the screen. In addition to the traditional power-ups, waves of enemies and bosses, there are 3 difficulty levels and six playable characters.

metadata.title: Deepak Chopra's Leela (USA)
metadata.description: Deepak Chopra's Leela for Xbox 360 offers a series of meditation exercises inspired by the work of Deepak Chopra, a renowned figure in Indian alternative medicine.

metadata.title: Def Jam Icon (Europe)
metadata.description: Def Jam Icon is a fighting game for Xbox 360. At the head of a famous US rap label, manage your company to make as much money as possible and hire the greatest rappers. But in this very hot universe, fights are also a must for you to impose your law. Six different fighting styles are offered, and all in a very rap atmosphere of course.

metadata.title: Def Jam Rapstar (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt)
metadata.description: Def Jam Rapstar is a rhythm game for Xbox 360. The title allows you to sing hip-hop alone or in pairs, with tracks such as My Humps by the Black Eyed Peas, Wild Thang by 2 Much, Mrs. Officer by Lil Wayne or Lean Wit It, Rock Wit It by the group Dem Franchise Boyz. It is also possible to create your own clips with the help of a very complete editor.

metadata.title: Defiance (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De)
metadata.description: Characters come from one of four Origins: Veterans, Outlaws, Machinists, or Survivalists. Veterans are a group of soldiers who survived The Pale Wars, a massive conflict between humans and aliens. Outlaws are criminals who raid and destroy for fortunes. Machinists are scavengers, who recover alien technology to make profits and a living from it. Survivalists are humans or aliens who attempt to survive in the newly formed, hostile world. Besides initial starter weapon and also costume - this choice, similar to Race (Human, Irathient, and Castithan) has no consequence in the later game, with all weapons, abilities and costumes being equally accessible to all players beyond the tutorial area.

metadata.title: Destiny (World)
metadata.description:
From the creators of Halo and the publisher of Call of Duty comes Destiny. With an unprecedented variety of FPS gameplay, Destiny promises to deliver an incredible story set within a newly-imagined, always-connected universe filled with action and adventure.

Everything changed with the arrival of the Traveler. It sparked a Golden Age when our civilization spanned the solar system ... but it didn't last. Something hit us, knocked us down. The survivors built a city beneath the Traveler, and have begun to explore our old worlds, only to find them filled with deadly foes. In Destiny, you are a Guardian of the last safe city on Earth, able to wield incredible power. Defend the City. Defeat our enemies. Reclaim all that we have lost.

metadata.title: Devil May Cry 4 (Japan)
metadata.description: Devil May Cry 4 immerses gamers in a gothic supernatural world, where a new protagonist clashes with a familiar hero. As the new leading man, Nero, players will unleash incredible attacks and non-stop combos using a unique new gameplay mechanic, his powerful "Devil Bringer" arm. Dynamic action and undeniable style combine with explosive fighting options and a gripping story to produce the incomparable experience that only a Devil May Cry game can deliver.

metadata.title: Diablo III (Brazil)(Es,Pt)
metadata.description:
The game takes place in Sanctuary, the dark fantasy world of the Diablo series. This world was saved twenty years prior by a handful of unnamed heroes in Diablo II, having survived the onslaught brought by the armies of the Burning Hells, who have gone mad from their ordeals. It is up to a new generation of heroes to face the forces of evil threatening the world of Sanctuary.

Players will have the opportunity to explore familiar settings such as Tristram.

The only confirmed NPCs are Deckard Cain, who has appeared in both of the previous games, and his niece, Leah, a new character who accompanies the hero in quests from time to time. The plot will revolve around two surviving Lesser Evils, Azmodan and Belial, and an artifact known as the Black Soulstone. Diablo's world map is composed primarily of two main continents with several small islands in the Northwest region. The world of Sanctuary has been dramatically changed by the destruction of the World Stone in Diablo II: Lord of Destruction.

metadata.title: Ducktales Remastered (USA)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt)
metadata.description: DuckTales: Remastered is a beautifully crafted reinvention of one of the most beloved 8-bit titles of all time. Return to the golden age of gaming, now enhanced with details that will appeal to the most dedicated Disney or retro Capcom fanatic. Featuring hand-drawn animated images, authentic Disney character voices and richly coloured backdrops from the classic TV series, Uncle Scrooge and his family are more alive than ever. The game retains the authenticity of its simple and fun 8-bit predecessor, with slight modifications to improve design and fluidity. Embark on an authentic DuckTales adventure as Uncle Scrooge and his three nephews travel to exotic locations around the world in search of five legendary treasures.

The player takes the control of Darwin who is member of a secret government organization consisting of guinea pigs. His mission: defending the evil industrial magnate Saber who manipulates home appliances and uses them as weapons. Not surprisingly these are the main foes in this game. But Darwin is not even close to helpless: various guns and gadgets, e.g. a jet pack, a electronic whip or a grappling hook, are used to dispatch of them. Most of the time is spent in fights but there are also puzzles. Many of them require the usage of Mooch, a fly.

metadata.title: Tron Evolution (Europe)(Beta)(2010-10-06)
metadata.description: Tron Evolution is played through a classic third-person perspective, similar to the Tomb Raider series. However, Anon - the player's character - is much more athletic than a typical character for this genre, and the player is able to travel across The Grid using Anon's "free runner" aerobatic techniques. The player attacks hostile Programs primarily with their Light Disk, through either melee or ranged attacks. They can also use the disk to block the attacks of other Programs. Derezzing (in-universe slang for killing/deleting) a Program grants experience points, which can be used to upgrade the player's abilities. The game also includes sequences where the player can control Light Cycles (like TRON 2.0) and Tanks (upgraded versions of the ones from the first movie).

metadata.title: Disney Universe (Russia)
metadata.description: Disney Universe is an action/adventure game for Xbox 360. Playable by 4 players in cooperation, the software allows you to evolve in different Disney universes such as Alice in Wonderland or Monsters & Co. The title offers the player more than 40 costumes inspired by the company's famous characters, each with specific abilities.

metadata.title: Disney-Pixar Cars
metadata.description: Cars is a racing game based on the animated movie of the same name. The player takes the role of Lightning McQueen in his quest to win the Piston Cup.

metadata.title: Cars : La Coupe Internationale de Martin (Europe)(Es,It)
metadata.description: Cars : La Coupe Internationale de Martin sur Xbox 360 vous replonge dans l'univers de Cars, le film d'animation de Pixar. Au volant des principales voitures "animées" du jeu, à vous de remporter toutes les compétitions du titre, en profitant également des défis et des mini-jeux disponibles.

metadata.title: Ratatouille (Europe)(Fr,De,Es,Nl,Pt)
metadata.description:
This game is based on the award winning Pixar movie of the same name. Remy is a rat who dreams of becoming a cook like his hero, the famous French chef Gusteau. Due to a series of unfortunate events, Remy finds himself in the sewers of Paris right below Gusteau's restaurant.

Unfortunately, it is difficult for a rat to find a job in the kitchen, but through his friendship with a clumsy janitor, Linguine, they are able to work together towards achieving their goals. Unfortunately, there are many obstacles that stand in their way – scheming chefs, health inspectors, food critics and even Remy's family.

This game features many of the conflicts in the film, but expands on it with six open world environments to explore. There are numerous minigames featured that can be unlocked for multiplayer. Remy has to navigate his way through kitchens and sewers with platform mechanics. There are cooking challenges as well as chase sequences.

metadata.title: Toy Story 3 (Europe)(Fr,De,It,Nl)
metadata.description: The Xbox 360 action game Toy Story 3 is a faithful adaptation of the film's storyline in which Buzz, Woody and his friends must come to terms with their uncertain future as Andy prepares to enter college. The title features several game modes, including a co-op mode and a level editor.

metadata.title: Disney-Pixar Up
metadata.description:
Journey through the undiscovered jungles of South America, in Up the video game.

You can control Russell, Carl, Dug the talking dog and a female bird named Kevin, or you can play with a friend through the entire game. Aided by Russell's wilderness knowledge, the four characters must work together to navigate treacherous jungle terrain, combat exotic animals and avoid being captured. Each character has special abilities that help in their journey. During the game, you will explore exciting environments, overcome obstacles and battle beasts in an effort to stop Muntz from capturing Kevin.

metadata.title: Disney-Pixar WALL-E
metadata.description: Based on the 2008 computer-animated film from Pixar Animation Studios, the video game version of WALL-E involves playing as the lonely robot as he navigates a trash-tainted world and begins an unlikely trek across the cosmos.

metadata.description: DJ Hero on Xbox 360 is a rhythm game that is played with a DJ turntable equipped with 3 keys that you have to press at the right time. But that's not all, there's also a crossfader that you have to move according to the keys you have to press, as well as an effects potentiometer. You also have the possibility to scratch with the turntable when you are asked to!

metadata.title: Dj Hero 2 (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: DJ Hero 2 for Xbox 360 is the second installment of the popular rhythm game that puts you behind the decks. Adding to the features of the original is the addition of a turntable/singer duo, where a second player will have to try their hand at karaoke. Players will be able to play songs ranging from Lady Gaga to The Chemicals Brothers and over 85 other artists. The title also offers the chance to play as famous DJs such as DJ Shadow, David Guetta and Wu-Tang Clan.

metadata.title: Dmc Devil May Cry (Japan)
metadata.description: DmC Devil May Cry is a Beat'em all on Xbox 360. The game's universe has been darkened and this episode allows you to play as Dante in his youth. Retaining the gameplay of the series, the title includes new weapons and new powers.

metadata.title: Dodonpachi Daioujou Black Label Extra (Japan)
metadata.description: DoDonPachi Daioujou Black Label Extra is a shoot'em up for Xbox 360. The title features 2D vertical scrolling gameplay, huge explosions, massive bosses and an arcade view. The Xbox 360 version differs from the original version in its enhanced graphics, downloadable content and online leaderboards. The game is also optimised for HD display.

metadata.title: Dodonpachi Resurrection (Europe)
metadata.description: DoDonPachi Resurrection is a shoot'em up developed for the arcade and then adapted for the Xbox 360. It is a manic shooter, meaning a title in which enemy fire can cover most of the screen. This Xbox 360 version offers three new modes compared to the original game: Novice mode, which is ideal for getting to grips with the game, Arrange A mode and Arrange B mode, both of which offer very specific scoring systems.

metadata.title: Don Bradman Cricket 14 (Australia)
metadata.description: Don Bradman Cricket 14 is a cricket tournament simulation for Xbox 360 that allows the player to play the sport. He has access to a large number of leagues, and can also play matches against other players.

metadata.title: Doom 3 Bfg Edition (Europe)
metadata.description: Doom 3 BFG Edition on Xbox 360 is a pack that includes the FPS Doom III and two expansions including the new Lost Mission. Doom III takes the player through the dark corridors of a Martian base invaded by the forces of hell.

metadata.title: Dragon Age Inquisition (Brazil)(En,Pt)(Disco 1)
metadata.description: Dragon Age: Inquisition is a role-playing game and the third main game in the Dragon Age series. It is set in the Thedas continent, the same fantasy world as the two previous games. It consist of two large countries: Ferelden (from Dragon Age: Origins) and Orlais, as well as the land inbetween. The story picks up after the events of the supplementary novels Dragon Age: Asunder and The Masked Empire describing a civil war in Orlais between the loyalists of the ruling Empress and a noble faction led by her cousin Grand Duke Gaspard.

metadata.title: Dragon Age : Origins (Germany)
metadata.description: Dragon Age: Origins is an Xbox 360 role-playing game based on a previously unseen fantasy universe. An intuitive team combat system allows you to defeat hordes of enemies. Depending on his alliances and his choices, the player can redefine the environment in which he evolves. Each player participates in a unique prelude that determines their vision of the world and how the world perceives it, which then has a great influence on the course of the adventure.

metadata.title: Dragon Age : Origins - Awakening (Japan)
metadata.description: Dragon Age: Origins - Awakening for Xbox 360 is an expansion for the role-playing game Dragon Age: Origins that offers new content (play areas, creatures, quests, companions in arms) but also new development possibilities for your players. characters. The story takes you to the Amaranthine region, where the surviving Spawn took refuge.

metadata.description: You are one of the few who escaped the destruction of your home. Now, forced to fight for survival in an ever-changing world, you must gather the deadliest of allies, amass fame and fortune, and seal your place in history. This is the story of how the world changed forever. The legend of your Rise to Power begins now.

metadata.title: Dragon Ball Raging Blast (Europe)
metadata.description: Dragon Ball: Raging Blast on Xbox 360 is a fighting game based on the universe developed by Akira Toriyama. This title features the various characters of the Dragon Ball licence and relives the nervous and spectacular battles that made it a success. Choose a fighter from the 70 available and get into the thick of the action.

metadata.title: Dragon Ball Raging Blast 2 (Europe)
metadata.description: You can play as more than 90 characters from the series and the OVAs released to date. Several game modes are available including multiplayer. In addition, there is a 30 minutes anime offered as a bonus.

metadata.title: Dragon Ball - Ultimate Blast
metadata.description: Kamehameha! Prepare to dive into the world of Dragon Ball Z with Earth-shaking combat, a massive character selection, faithful manga-style graphics, and exciting new features in Dragon Ball Z: Ultimate Tenkaichi! Delivering an explosive DBZ fighting experience, this game features upgraded environmental and character graphics, with designs drawn from the original manga series. Destructible battlefields, including massive craters and ki blasts cutting across the sky deliver a more dynamic experience and immediate sense of urgency to the exhilarating fights. An enhanced story mode drops players into the rich Dragon Ball Z universe, filled with beloved characters and powerful enemies. An accessible battle system allows gamers of all ages to hold their own in fast-paced battles, while still retaining tactical depth for hardcore fans.

metadata.title: Dragon Ball Xenoverse (Europe)
metadata.description:
Goku and OTHERS fiercest battles will be reborn!

DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE will revisit all famous battles from the series thanks to the Avatar, who is connected to Trunks and many other characters. Are this connection and his will to intervene in fights strong enough to fix the History as we know it? Coming along with these amazing features, the mysterious Toki Toki City, new gameplay mechanics, character animation and many other amazing features!

metadata.title: Dragon Ball Z : Battle of Z (Europe)
metadata.description: Dragon Ball Z Battle of Z will feature a large cast of playable characters including Goku, Piccolo, Vegeta, and a variety of melee and famous attacks including the Kamehameha, Special Beam Cannon, and Spirit Bomb. The epic battles in Dragon Ball Z Battle of Z derive their style from the original anime series and will take place in rich environments on both land and in the air. Dragon Ball Z Battle of Z will let players form teams with up to four characters to participate in group melee action, take on massive boss battles, or challenge other players around the world for brawls featuring up to eight characters on screen at the same time.

The title takes the story of the famous manga (and cartoon) and the scenario of Dragon Ball Z to focus on the invasion of the Earth by Saiyan warriors. Control the twenty or so characters available, with their ultimate moves and techniques. An online mode is available, for numerous long-distance battles.

metadata.title: Dragon Ball Z Ultimate Tenkaichi (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Dragon Ball Z Ultimate Tenkaichi is a fighting game for Xbox 360. A new opus dedicated to the universe of Akira Toriyama in which the player takes part in 3D battles in destructible settings against the AI or against other players locally but also online. The game introduces a character creation system.

metadata.title: Dragon Ball Z For Kinect (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Dragon Ball Z: For Kinect is a 3D one-on-one fighting game based on the Dragon Ball Z anime television series. It is played from a first-person perspective and the character can only controlled through the Kinect motion recognition peripheral. It is the first console game in the series to use a first-person perspective and in that way it draws inspiration from the arcade game Dragon Ball Z: V.R.V.S., while visually it closely resembles the style of the earlier Dragon Ball Z: Ultimate Tenkaichi games by the same developer.

metadata.title: Dragon's Dogma (World)
metadata.description: A legend is born in this open-world adventure. Assume the role of the Arisen, a legendary hero in a land haunted by a feared, omnipotent dragon. As you fight to protect your homeland, you will pick up companions, make enemies, and find yourself embroiled in an even deeper mystery.

metadata.title: Dragon's Dogma : Dark Arisen (World)(Disc 1)(Game Disc)
metadata.description: Dragon's Dogma: Dark Arisen is an expansion for the Xbox 360 action role-playing game Dragon's Dogma, which is included in this release. Among the additions is Amerture's Reef, an island for high-level players with new weapons and monsters.

metadata.title: Dream C Club (Japan)
metadata.description: Dream C Club is a pick-up game in which you have to please hostesses by buying them drinks, food, etc. Unfortunately, to do so, you will have to collect enough money by working like a slave on weekends. An atypical game and therefore for an informed public.

metadata.title: Dreamcast Collection (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: Sega Dreamcast Collection on 360 is a compilation of 4 games originally released on Dreamcast. It includes Crazy Taxi, Sega Bass Fishing, Space Channel 5: Part 2 and of course Sonic Adventures.

metadata.title: Bee Movie Game (Europe)
metadata.description: Bee Movie on Xbox 360 is an action game based on the feature film of the same name. You play as a bee who doesn't want to end up working in the same company and who will try different jobs to find what suits him best. These jobs are all mini-games that you can play in addition to the levels you have to go through. Use your height-related abilities to get out of dangerous situations and find the job of your dreams.

metadata.title: Kung Fu Panda 2 (USA)
metadata.description: The action game Kung Fu Panda 2 is an adaptation of the movie of the same name for Xbox 360. This particular version uses Kinect to let you slip into the shoes of Po, the famous noodle and kung fu loving panda. The motion-recognition accessory allows you to mimic the blows Po delivers to his enemies in your living room.

metadata.title: Madagascar 2 (USA)
metadata.description: The crazy animals of Madagascar are back on Xbox 360! In this second opus, save the African savannah and relive the best moments of the film. You play as Alex the lion, Marty the zebra, Melman the giraffe and Gloria the hippo. There are 13 different levels, as well as 10 mini-games, using moves specific to each character.

metadata.title: Madagascar 3 : Bons Baisers d'Europe (USA)
metadata.description: Madagascar 3 sur Xbox 360 reprend les personnages du film du même nom dans un jeu d'action très aérien. Alex, Marty, Gloria et Melman doivent en effet faire la publicité d'un cirque à travers diverses villes européennes. Leurs numéros sont variés et mettent en avant les amis du quatuor. On retrouve donc aussi les lémuriens, les pingouins, ou le jaguar.

metadata.title: Madagascar Kartz (USA)
metadata.description:
Come On, Let's Move It!

Experience the zany characters and unique locations of the Madagascar movies in the over the top fun of arcade style racing. Put the pedal to the metal Madagascar style with wacky kartz, wild tracks, unique pick-ups and more! Buckle up, strap in and get your animal instincts in high gear!

Features

• YOUR FAVORITE MADAGASCAR CHARACTERS - Including Alex, Marty, Gloria, and Melman, the wacky King Julien and the crafty penguins• KRAZY KART ACTION - High flying jumps, flips, rolls, and stunts. Special reward structure for krazy maneuvers• HEAD-TO-HEAD MULTIPLAYER - Take on up to four of your friends• GRAB THE WHEEL FOR KRAZY KART ACTION - Compatible with the Wii Wheel and most other licensed steering wheels.

metadata.description: Turbo: Super Stunt Squad  is an action/racing game available on the Xbox 360. Control one of the heroes from the movie of the same name, each with their own driving style, tricks and special skills. You can customise your character, find shortcuts on the tracks, and perform amazing stunts using the scenery to gain an advantage in the race. You can also play with a friend in cooperation.
