metadata.title: Driver : San Francisco (Europe)(Pl,Ru)
metadata.description: Driver: San Francisco is a racing game for Xbox 360 in which you play as Tanner, a man who has fallen into a coma following an accident. You'll be able to drive a hundred vehicles, from big cars to the Fiat 500, and thanks to the shift system, you'll be able to change cars as you please with the help of a cursor.

metadata.title: Duck Dynasty (USA)
metadata.description: Duck Dynasty is a point-and-click action-shooter for 360 that lets you play as John Luke, trying to become a Robertson family man. Go duck hunting, and learn to live in the town of West Monroe.

metadata.title: Duke Nukem Forever (Japan)
metadata.description: Duke Nukem Forever is a first-person shooter for Xbox 360. If the hero of Duke Nukem exterminated his first aliens as early as 1991, it was Duke Nukem 3D that made the character famous in 1996. Well-known for his sense of humour and his poetic finesse, the tall blond man with dark glasses is back years later to the delight of his fans!

metadata.title: Dungeon Siege III (Japan)
metadata.description: Dungeon Siege III is an action/adventure game for Xbox 360. The main character is fully customisable and our choices in the game can have an influence on the scenario. In addition, four players can enjoy cooperative play in this hero-fantasy world.

metadata.title: Dynasty Warriors : Gundam (Europe)
metadata.description: Find the principle of the Dynasty Warriors saga, i.e. alone against hundreds of opponents, transposed into the world of Mechas. This is what this opus, subtitled Gundam, offers on Xbox 360. Control overarmed robots and roam gigantic maps populated by enemies that you send flying. The more you progress, the more you improve the characteristics of your robot.

metadata.title: Dynasty Warriors : Gundam 2 (Europe)
metadata.description: Dynasty Warriors Gundam 2 on Xbox 360 is a futuristic beat'em all inviting us to take down hundreds of enemies using powerful mechas. You will be able to select numerous pilots and fully customise more than 60 robots before heading out onto the battlefield to complete the hundreds of missions that await you.

metadata.title: Dynasty Warriors : Gundam 3 (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: Dynasty Warriors: Gundam 3 on Xbox 360 is a beat'em all in the tradition of the famous Koei series. Featuring a new cel-shaded graphical look, the title welcomes new mechas and an online cooperative mode. It also allows us to summon assistants in battle or customise our robots in great detail.

metadata.title: Dynasty Warriors : Strikeforce (Europe)
metadata.description: Dynasty Warriors: Strikeforce on Xbox 360 is a multiplayer beat'em all featuring the main heroes of the Three Kingdoms. After preparing his equipment in town, the player can invite his friends to join him to try to overcome the many challenges that await him on various battlefields. All characters now change their appearance when they switch to Fury mode and can fight both on land and in the air.

metadata.title: Dynasty Warriors 5 : Empires (Europe)
metadata.description: Dynasty Warriors 5: Empires on Xbox 360 is an action game in which you will explore China in the company of legendary warriors. Before each battle, gather your war council to determine the military and political rules of the kingdom, and then fight! Choose the officers of your attack force, control over 2,000 officers, try to attract captured lieutenants to your cause or drive them out of your kingdom.

metadata.title: Dynasty Warriors 6 (Europe)
metadata.description: Dynasty Warriors 6 on Xbox 360 is a beat'em all set in medieval China. Lead the 40 historical characters of the title, each with their own past and personal motivation. Various single player modes are available, as well as a two player split screen mode. The War of the Three Kingdoms is full of twists and turns.

metadata.title: Dynasty Warriors 6 : Empires (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: Dynasty Warriors 6: Empires is a beat'em all for Xbox 360. The story takes place in China during the Three Kingdoms period. The Empires mode brings a tactical dimension to the gameplay of the cult saga: this time you can create your own empire and its alliances and even betray your allies!

metadata.title: Dynasty Warriors 7 (Europe)
metadata.description: Dynasty Warriors 7 is an action game that once again invites us to wage war in medieval China on Xbox 360. More than sixty characters capable of wielding 35 different weapons are available to embark on a lengthy story mode or a particularly strategic conquest mode. A tutorial and a vast encyclopaedia are also available to immerse yourself in the exciting world of the Three Kingdoms.

metadata.title: Dynasty Warriors 8 (USA)
metadata.description:
The main mode in this latest installment in the Dynasty Warriors series is Story Mode, which follows the stories of the kingdoms of Wei, Wu, Shu, and Jin. 
This completely new story includes new episodes with all-new characters and takes an ever deeper look at the drama that unfolds in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms compared to previous titles in the series.
There are also new "What If?" scenarios that take a look at what could have happened if famous characters of the time period had lived on to fight another day.

metadata.title: Ea Sports Mma (USA, Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es)
metadata.description:
EA SPORT MMA brings the authenticity of the world's most intense combat sport home like never before. Go on the offensive with a dynamic control system for strikes, elbows, knees and kicks and strategically manage advances and counters with an intuitive submission system. Battle it out in the Strikeforce cage or deliver vicious soccer kicks and head stomps in a ring in Japan. Are you ready? Let's get it on!

The multiplayer functionality of this title is NO longer available. You will ONLY have access to the single player aspects of the game after download.

metadata.title: Earth Defense Force : Insect Armageddon (Europe)
metadata.description: Earth Defense Force: Insect Armageddon is a pure action game for Xbox 360. The Earth is once again invaded by giant insects and it is up to the player, a member of the Earth Defense Force, to defeat them. The title takes place in the fictional city of New Detroit. A campaign is available to bring together up to 2 players in cooperative play, as well as multiplayer where you have to face wave after wave of enemies. A large number of weapons ensure the show.

metadata.title: Force De Défense Terrestre 2017 (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: Force de Défense Terrestre 2017 est un jeu d'action sur Xbox 360. Pendant 53 niveaux, le joueur doit maintenir son doigt sur la gâchette pour vaporiser des hordes de créatures et de robots, le tout sur des cartes à dominante urbaine. Un mode 2 joueurs en écran splitté est également disponible.

metadata.title: Earth Defense Force 2025 (USA)
metadata.description: Earth Defense Force 2025 is an action game for Xbox 360 in which the player must fight against swarms of insects to protect the earth.

metadata.title: El Chavo Kart
metadata.description:
El Chavo Kart is a mascot-based kart racing game, in the same vein as Konami Krazy Racers, Nicktoons Racing, Mickey's Speedway USA, Diddy Kong Racing, Crash Team Racing and the Mario Kart series. Players get to compete as characters from the series (except for Jamito and Gloria), along with tracks loosely based on locations from the animated series.

The game offers three game modes: Cups, Exhibition, and Challenges. In "Cups", the player can unlock characters, while at the end of "Challenges" scenarios and tracks are unlocked. The player can collect power-ups along the race which can be used to benefit himself and gain an advantage in the race. Tracks include series features and scenarios such as Azteca Stadium, the city of Acapulco, the Maracana Stadium in Rio de Janeiro and also Stadium TFC in Toulouse. Each track can be raced in the opposite direction, and include alternative paths, traps and obstacles. The game features local multiplayer, allowing up to four players to compete against each other simultaneously. The game features 45 trophies or achievements that can be unlocked to progress through the game.

metadata.title: El Shaddai : Ascension of the Metatron (Europe)
metadata.description: El Shaddai: Ascension of the Metatron is an action game for Xbox 360. Its story is based on the apocryphal Book of Enoch and tells the story of Enoch's journey sent by God to hunt down renegade angels. Enoch is guided in his mission by Lucifer, before he himself becomes a fallen angel. The gameplay alternates between combat and platforming sequences, and the title surprises with its original visual approach.

metadata.title: Elder Scrolls V : Skyrim, The (Germany)
metadata.description:
Two hundred years after the events described in Oblivion, the continent of Tamriel is in turmoil. The Emperor's throne remained without heir; the Blades, Empire's elite guards, have been disassembled; elven nations began capturing territory from the Empire. The assassination of the King of Skyrim, Tamriel's Northern-most province and home of the Nord race, led to a civil war between those who wish independence for Skyrim and those who wanted it to remain under the Empire's control.

A prisoner is brought to a small town, awaiting execution for alleged involvement with the Stormcloaks, a group that was founded by the king's assassin Ulfric Stormcloak. Just before the executioner's axe lands on the prisoner's neck, a dragon attacks the city, forcing most people to flee. The unexpected freedom leads the ex-prisoner into the snowy Skyrim, where the rumors of the dragon begin to circulate.

metadata.title: Enchanted Arms (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: Enchanted Arms is a role-playing game for Xbox 360. You play as Atsuma, the main hero, who has to fight against the ice witch, who is determined to raise her supremacy to a global level. It's up to you to go on an adventure, in the company of golems, created by mixing various materials.

metadata.title: End of Eternity (Japan)
metadata.description:
In the distant future, humanity is threatened with extinction because the Earth is polluted. The survivors turn to Basel, an immense machine programmed to preserve the environment, and leave it in charge of managing the life and death cycles of the planet and its inhabitants.
The curtain is about to open on the group of mercenaries you play. Their fate, intertwined with that of unstoppable machines and a mysterious caste of oligarchs, now depends solely on you.
Experience an exciting story whose conclusion will seal the fate of humanity. Let yourself be captivated by a unique combat system offering thrilling strategic confrontations, and by magnificent musical compositions.

metadata.title: Enemy Front (Germany)
metadata.description: Enemy Front is an Xbox 360 FPS that takes us into the middle of World War II. Working behind Nazi lines in both France and Germany, the player must carry out sabotage missions to prevent a destructive weapon from being created that will ultimately change the course of the war.

metadata.title: Enemy Territory : Quake Wars (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Enemy Territory: Quake Wars is a multiplayer FPS for Xbox 360. It takes place in 2060 on an Earth invaded by the Stroggs, alien cyborgs. Faced with this threat, the resistance is organized in the World Defense Force. The two factions compete on a dozen maps where one team defends objectives while the other tries to destroy or take control of them. Victory requires good coordination between the different character classes available

metadata.title: Enslaved : Odyssey to the West (USA, Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description:
Enslaved: Odyssey to the West is a platforming action-adventure developed by Ninja Theory. In the game, the player controls Monkey in his escorting mission of Trip. Monkey is equipped with an extend-able staff which he uses in battle. As the name implies, Monkey has acrobatic skills like a monkey that he uses perfectly to climb on poles and escape from enemies. 

Combat is tied exclusively to Monkey's staff, delivering light or heavy blows and even shooting out plasma shots. While Trip does not help in the actual fighting, she can help in other ways like distracting the enemies or even unleashing a stunning EMP if she is attacked. Trip also uses a dragonfly camera that will scour the surrounding areas for mechs and mines. If any are found, they will show up on screen thanks to it being programmed into Monkey's headband. Tech-orbs found scattered throughout the levels are used for upgrading purposes.

metadata.title: Eragon (Europe)
metadata.description: Eragon for Xbox 360 is an action game based on the movie of the same name in which you must fulfill the destiny of a dragon player. Take part in epic battles against the terrifying forces of the evil king with your powerful dragon Saphira. Fight alongside her or on her back... You can also control Saphira in the air to take on the forces of Galbatorix. Crush your enemies with a combat system that features grabs, combos and magic attacks.

metadata.title: Escape Dead Island (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: Escape Dead Island is a spin-off from the main Dead Island series, outside of the main canon, and it is done by a different developer. Unlike the main series it is played from a third-person perspective. The visuals are changed to a cel shaded look with action words that appear on the screen similar to comic books. In this survival action game the player controls Cliff Calo who travels with two friends to the Banoi archipelago, mainly the Narapela island, to investigate the reports about strange events there. His main goal is to gather evidence by taking pictures with his camera, proving the Geopharm corporation is active on the islands. The game's tutorial is set slightly before the rest of the game where the player controls the operative Kilo Two who infiltrates a Geopharm facility to discover the identity of the mole, two days before the outbreak. Xian Mei, from the main game series, also appears as a character in the game.

metadata.title: Eschatos (Japan)
metadata.description: Eschatos is a shoot'em up for Xbox 360. Aboard your plane, chase a gigantic ship that sends you all sorts of objects that are all pitfalls. The player relies on his shield to face them in this arcade game in the purest style of the 80s.

metadata.title: Espgaluda II Black Label (Japan)(Shokai Genteiban)
metadata.description: Espgaluda II Black Label is a shoot'em up for Xbox 360. In this one you have to help a witch to destroy her enemies. As in all games of this kind you have to shoot your enemies while avoiding their shots which is sometimes difficult when many opponents are present on the screen.

metadata.title: Eternal Sonata (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: The hero of Eternal Sonata is a real historical character, the famous 19-century Polish composer Frédéric Chopin. The game begins with Chopin lying on his deathbed and having a strange dream in which he is transferred into a fantasy world where places and people have musically sounding names. Chopin encounters a girl named Polka, a magician who is on the run from her own destiny (since all magicians die young in her world). Other people join them on a quest to overthrow an evil nobleman. Events from Chopin's real life are shown as parallels to what happens in his dream.

metadata.title: Ever 17
metadata.description: An remastered version of Ever17 for PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch and PC.

metadata.title: Every Party (Japan)
metadata.description:
The game plays as a board game in which up to four players compete to be the first to reach a goal. Each board features multiple routes, with some being shorter and riskier, while others are longer but potentially more lucrative in terms of prizes. There are a number (30+) of different mini games which can be triggered during play, similar to the Mario Party series.

Before play begins, players select a character and customize the character with a variety of items and accessories unlocked during previous sessions. When playing online via Xbox Live, this helps provide a unique appearance as compared to other players.

metadata.title: Everyone Sing (Europe)
metadata.description:
Get the party started with "Everyone Sing" featuring top artists - Nicki Minaj, Nicole Scherzinger, Taio Cruz, The Wanted, Jessie J & more!

Sing to hit tracks either with or against your family and friends, or sing together in your own group. Multiplayer available on every track. Excellent solo play and multiple party modes, including "Know Your Song", "Pass the Bomb" and "Group Mode" for creating your own singing group. Compatible with all existing microphones.

metadata.title: Every Party (Asia)(En,Zh,Ko)
metadata.description:
The game plays as a board game in which up to four players compete to be the first to reach a goal. Each board features multiple routes, with some being shorter and riskier, while others are longer but potentially more lucrative in terms of prizes. There are a number (30+) of different mini games which can be triggered during play, similar to the Mario Party series.

Before play begins, players select a character and customize the character with a variety of items and accessories unlocked during previous sessions. When playing online via Xbox Live, this helps provide a unique appearance as compared to other players.

metadata.title: Evil Within, The (Europe)(Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description:
Pure Survival Horror Returns; Shinji Mikami, the father of survival horror, is back to direct a chilling new game wrapped in haunting narrative. Tension and anxiety heighten dramatically as you explore the game's tortured world.
Brutal Traps and Twisted Creatures; Face unthinkable horrors and cruel traps as you struggle to survive against overwhelming odds. Turn evil against itself by using the same diabolical devices against overwhelming deadly creatures.
Unknown Threats in an Uncertain World; Mysterious and wicked fears loom ahead in a world that warps and twists around you.
The New Face of Horror; Highly-crafted environments, horrifying anxiety, and an intricate story weave together to create an immersive world that will bring players to the height of tension.

metadata.title: F.E.A.R. 2 : Project Origin (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description:
F.E.A.R. 2: Project Origin is the sequel to F.E.A.R.: First Encounter Assault Recon and continues the series' trademark blend of supernatural horror and suspense. Many mechanics from the original first-person shooter have made their way into the game, like slow motion bullet time, and intelligent AI. New gameplay elements have also been introduced, like grab and drag movable cover, combat mechs, and iron sight aiming. The environments are now more open and less linear than those in the first game, and are also more diverse.
Point-Man, the protagonist of the first F.E.A.R. has been replaced by a new playable character, Michael Becket, a Delta Force operator who has been sent on a mission to arrest Armacham president Genevieve Aristide approximately 30 minutes before the ending of the first game. Alma, the strange little girl returns to give you scares and also assist you at some points.
The game only takes the original game into account and ignores all events from the expansion packs Extraction Point and Perseus Mandate.

metadata.title: F.e.a.r. (Germany)
metadata.description: F.E.A.R is a first-person shooter for Xbox 360. You are part of the First Encounter Assault Recon unit, which will plunge you into a horrific and terrible mission. The atmosphere of the game is creepy and scary as hell, especially as monsters and enemies swarm in. The multiplayer can accommodate 16 players for 8 different challenges including Deathmatch (solo or team), CDD (normal or slowed down) or Elimination.

metadata.title: F.e.a.r. Files (Germany)
metadata.description: F.E.A.R. Files on Xbox 360 includes the two expansions for F.E.A.R., namely Extraction Point and Perseus Mandate. This first-person shooter has a very special atmosphere, with a paranormal atmosphere and a little girl whispering in your ear before going through the walls. New Instant Action modes, a more intense scenario and new maps for multiplayer are available.

metadata.title: F1 2010 (Japan)
metadata.description: Available on Xbox 360, F1 2010 is a racing game that allows the player to drive a Formula 1 car around the various championship circuits. Choose your driver, select your car and head to the circuits of your choice. Whether it's Monaco or Silverstone, put your foot to the floor, clear the competition out of your way and climb onto the podium.

metadata.title: F1 2011 (Brazil)(En,Pt)
metadata.description: F1 2011 on Xbox 360 is a Formula 1 racing game. With a strong focus on simulation, this game offers you the chance to take part in the different Grand Prix of 2011, from Germany to Japan. In addition to new circuits, the game also includes new drivers and new rules in the discipline.

metadata.title: F1 2012 (Brazil)(En,Pt)
metadata.description: F1 2012 for Xbox 360 is the official racing game of the Formula 1 World Championship. Aspiring drivers can take on the latest world champions in scripted challenges or launch a career in the Young Driver Test mode. There are also online races for up to 16 players.

metadata.title: F1 2013 (Brazil)(En,Pt)
metadata.description: F1 2013 is a Formula 1 simulation available on Xbox 360. The player can experience his own career alongside the current drivers or take part in legendary races against Nigel Mansell, Damon Hill, Michael Schumacher or Alain Prost. Circuits such as Brands Hatch and Jerez are also playable.

metadata.title: F1 2014 (Brazil)(En,Pt)
metadata.description: F1 2014 is a racing game available for Xbox 360. With the official licences of the 2014 Formula 1 World Championship, it also includes all its new features, starting with the V6 turbo engines, 8-speed gearboxes and the Spielberg and Sochi circuits. It is then possible to live your own career or to race alone or with up to 16 drivers online on one of the 19 circuits of the game.

metadata.title: F1 Race Stars (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt,Pl)
metadata.description: F1 Race Stars is a racing game for Xbox 360. The player can play as all the drivers of the 2012 Formula 1 season and drive around revamped circuits with loops, jumps and other shortcuts. Various power-ups are also included, including heat-seeking bullets, boosts, missiles, and a safety car that slows down the leader.

metadata.title: Fable : The Journey (Europe)(En,It,Pt)
metadata.description: Fable: The Journey is the fourth main game in the series and requires the Kinect peripheral to play. It is an open world action RPG game and follows the story of a young Dweller named Gabriel through the world of Albion set 50 years after the events of Fable III. The story centers around Gabriel, Theresa and the corruption that is starting to destroy Albion. With Theresa's help, Gabriel must face the corruption and its various creatures head-on, by casting magic. This is performed through various hand gestures. These are created in a spell crafting mode where players can draw items with their hands and then use them as spells. That way the player can craft shields or weapons, but also items such as a telescope or a fishing rod to use in mini-games. A large part of the game is spent riding a horse. The player has to guide the reins and also look after the horse when it is hurt

metadata.title: Fable Anniversary (Europe)(En,De,It,Ru)
metadata.description:
For Every Choice A Consequence

This role-playing adventure puts you in full control of the choices that will determine your skills, appearance, and reputation. Create your life story from your early years as an inexperienced warrior to the prime of life as you become the most powerful being in the world. Choose the path of righteousness or dedicate your life to evil. And don't forget to hide the chickens ? Jack of Blades is back.

metadata.title: Fable II (Germany)
metadata.description: Fable 2 is an action role-playing game that truly allows players to live the life they choose in an unimaginably open world environment. Set 500 years after the original, Fable 2 will provide gamers with an epic story and innovative real-time gameplay, including a massive amount of freedom and choice to explore a vast collection of dungeons, catacombs and caves in the world of Albion.

metadata.title: Fable III (France)
metadata.description: Set 50 years after the events of Fable II, the continent of Albion (where the Fable series is set) is under the control of Logan, a tyrant king and the Hero's older brother. The player's character, the "Hero", is forced into a quest to become a revolutionary leader to defeat Logan after he reveals his true personality to the Hero. Over the course of the first half of the game, the Hero will overthrow Logan and become ruler of Albion themselves. During the second half of the game, a strange force from Aurora, called The Darkness will threaten Albion and the player has to decide how to react to it.

metadata.title: Facebreaker (Europe)(En,Fr,De)(Beta)(2008-06-08)
metadata.description: Get in the ring with a group of eccentric cartoon characters who are just waiting to give you a beating! Facebreaker is an arcade-style boxing game in which you take on your opponent in a series of three rounds until one of you is knocked out. If there is no winner after three rounds, the game switches to sudden death mode and the first person to be knocked out wins. The game also features a tricky move called the "Facebreaker": if you land this move on your opponent, you instantly win the match.

metadata.title: Fairytale Fights (Europe)(Beta)(2009-09-04)
metadata.description: Fairytale Fights on Xbox360 is a platformer and action game that offers the player to discover the world of fairy tales in a trashy version. Playing as a total of four characters, you can chainsaw your enemies with Little Red Riding Hood or kick them off the screen with Snow White. The title gives you the opportunity to rediscover the stories of the fairy tales from a different perspective.

metadata.title: Falling Skies : Le Jeu Vidéo (Brazil)(En,Fr,Es,Pt)
metadata.description:
Mixing role-playing and strategy, the adventure will take place in the tense and uncompromising world of the series created by Amblin Television.
The survival of the human race is at stake! Players will plunge into a world on the brink of collapse. They will command a squad of survivors recruited from the resistance fighting to save the planet. The team will then engage in operations against the Espheni. They must survive the alien invasion while rescuing humans and recruiting survivors to join the 2nd Division. With effective, strategy-based gameplay, players will be immersed in a unique story featuring all the heroes from the series.

metadata.title: Fallout New Vegas (France)(Disque 2)
metadata.description:
Welcome to Vegas. New Vegas.
It's the kind of place where you'll dig your own grave before you get your head bashed in. It's a city where desperados fight each other for control of rare oases. The kind of place where the right person with the right equipment can make all the difference... and a lot of enemies.
From the Mojave desert to the Vegas strip, via the Hoover Dam, you'll meet a host of endearing and colourful characters. Make the right alliances and choose your side to become the master of Vegas. The game offers great freedom to evolve and interact with the universe, from 'persuading' others (in every sense of the word) to massively destroying your enemies by satellite.

metadata.title: Fallout 3 (Asia)
metadata.description: Fallout 3 takes place in the year 2277, 36 years after the setting of Fallout 2 and 200 years after the nuclear apocalypse that devastated the game's world in a future where international conflicts culminated in a Sino-American war in the second half of the 21st century. The game places the player in the role of an inhabitant of Vault 101, a survival shelter the size of a village, designed to protect a small number of humans from the nuclear fallout. When the player character's father disappears under mysterious circumstances, the player is forced to escape from the Vault and journey into the ruins of Washington D.C. to track him down. Along the way the player is assisted by a number of human survivors and must battle a myriad of enemies that inhabit the area now known as the "Capital Wasteland".

metadata.title: Family Games (Toys R Us)

metadata.title: Z'animo Fantastic, Les (USA)
metadata.description: In Fantastic Pets on Xbox 360, you can adopt a normal animal and transform it into a fantastic creature. Using Kinect, you can interact with it by gesture or voice.

metadata.title: Far Cry 2 (Japan)
metadata.description: The sequel to Far Cry 1, this second game on Xbox 360 no longer takes you to a paradise island, but to the heart of the African savannah. Equipped with an even more powerful graphics engine, the title invites you to discover or rediscover the very special world of Far Cry and its devastating weapons.

metadata.title: Far Cry 3 : Blood Dragon (USA)
metadata.description: The player controls an American cybernetic super-soldier named Sergeant Rex "Power" Colt. He and another American cyber-soldier known as T.T. "Spider" Brown travel to an unnamed island to investigate Colonel Sloan, an elite agent who has gone rogue.

metadata.title: Far Cry 3 (Europe, Asia)(En,Pl,Ru)
metadata.description:
Far Cry 3 is an open world first-person shooter set on the fictional Rook archipelago in the Pacific. Even though the tropical setting resembles the original Far Cry, the gameplay itself is closer to Far Cry 2 as the open world exploration is supplemented by role-playing elements with experience points, crafting, trading, hunting and three skills trees.

The protagonist is Jason Brody, a daredevil who is on a holiday in the Pacific with his two brothers and some friends. When they take a skydiving trip, they land on an island that is controlled by pirates. They are all taken prisoner by the pirate warlord Vaas and his older brother Grant is killed when they attempt to escape. Vaas sarcastically gives Jason an opportunity of 30 seconds to escape before he hunts him down.

metadata.title: Far Cry 4 (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl,Sv,No,Da,Fi,Pl,Cs)
metadata.description: Far Cry 4 is the fourth main game in the open world action series. It has no narrative ties to Far Cry 3, but carries over many gameplay elements. The game is set in Kyrat, a fictional region based on the Himalayan regions of Nepal. It is governed by the depostic king Pagan Min. The player controls Ajay Ghale, an American with Kyrati roots who returns to the region to disperse his deceased mother's ashes. As soon as he arrives he is dragged into the conflict and is rescued by the rebel organization The Golden Path started by his parents. During the game the Ajay can eventually choose which force to side with, with different endings.

metadata.title: Far Cry Instincts Predator (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: In Far Cry Instincts Predator, a first-person shooter for Xbox 360, you play as the indomitable Jack Carver, a man caught up in his past while living a peaceful life on a tropical island. Hunted by a horde of elite mercenaries, your survival skills and legendary predatory instincts will be your best weapons to stay alive.

metadata.title: Farming Simulator (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl,Pl)
metadata.description: Farming Simulator 2013 is a farm management game for Xbox 360. As the head of a vast estate, the player must tend to his livestock and cultivate his fields with the help of a hundred vehicles of major brands. This 2013 edition includes new animals, more varied crops and a cooperative mode accepting up to 10 players online.

metadata.title: Farming Simulator 15 (USA)
metadata.description: Farming Simulator 15 was released to Windows and Mac OS on October 30, 2014. This version introduced forestry, washable vehicles. 41 brands, amounting to around 140 pieces of equipment are in the new game, 160 in the 'gold edition' DLC pack. Farming Simulator 15 was released to consoles on May 19, 2015.

metadata.title: Fast & Furious - Showdown
metadata.description: Strap in and get ready for an intense ride as you team up to take down a dangerous international gang that can only be stopped by you and the rest of the Fast & Furious crew.

metadata.title: Fatal Inertia (Japan)
metadata.description: Fatal Inertia on Xbox 360 takes you on a futuristic race in vehicles that can reach 900 km/h. Several weapons and power-ups can be used in the game to destabilise opponents or to gain an advantage yourself.

There are six leagues, 177 clubs, 37 national teams and all licensed players. Play the career mode which allows you to develop a single player throughout his sporting life. The joys of football and boots are yours!

metadata.title: FIFA 08 - World Class Soccer
metadata.description:
FIFA 08 (named FIFA Soccer 08 in North America) is the 2007 installment of EA Sports' series of football video games. Developed by EA Canada, it is published by Electronic Arts worldwide under the EA Sports label. It was released on all popular gaming formats in September 2007 in Europe, Australia, and Asia, and in October 2007 in North America. The PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 versions of the game feature an improved game engine with superior graphics and different commentators and are dubbed "next-generation" by EA. On all other platforms—including the PC—the game utilizes an older engine. The Nintendo DS version features fewer teams, stadiums, game modes and kits due to the limitations of the machine's storage medium.

Commentary comes from Sky Sports' Martin Tyler and Andy Gray on next generation consoles; however, ITV Sports' Clive Tyldesley partners Gray on current generation consoles, and the PC version of the game. On the DS version of the game, Tyldesley is by himself. It also marks the first time the Nintendo GameCube has been excluded from the FIFA lineup since FIFA 2001 and the first the original Xbox and Game Boy Advance has been excluded from the FIFA lineup since FIFA Football 2002.

The tagline for the game is "Can You FIFA 08?."[2] The theme song is "Sketches (20 Something Life)" by La Rocca, from the album The Truth.

metadata.title: Fifa 08 (Asia)
metadata.description: EA is releasing its 2008 version of its flagship football licence FIFA on Xbox 360. The title features 620 teams, 30 leagues and over 15,000 licensed players. Train offline before taking on your opponents in online leagues. Participate in numerous tournaments, improve your skills with training and monitor the transfer market. Get into heated games with friends and become the king of the game.

metadata.title: Fifa 09 (Europe)(En,Nl,Sv)
metadata.description: Put on your boots, the 2009 version of FIFA on Xbox 360 is getting a head start, with no less than 250 changes announced, some major, some minor. In the end, the development of the "Become a Pro" mode over 4 seasons and above all the possibility of playing 10 against 10 online are the major contributions of this vintage.

metadata.title: FIFA 09 - World Class Soccer
metadata.description: FIFA 09 (titled FIFA Soccer 09 in North America) is the 2008 installment of Electronic Arts' FIFA series of football video games. Developed by EA Canada, it is published by Electronic Arts worldwide under the EA Sports label. It was released in October 2008 for Windows, Nintendo DS, PlayStation 2, PlayStation 3, PlayStation Portable, Wii, Xbox 360 and Zeebo. It was later in November 2008 released for the N-Gage 2.0 and Mobile phone.

metadata.title: Fifa 10 (Europe)(Es,Cs,Hu)
metadata.description: Put on your jersey and boots and get ready for the game. Available on Xbox 360, FIFA 10 is a football simulation in which you choose your team and players and then compete for the cup. This version fixes some of the bugs from the previous year and adds precision in handling and balance between players.

metadata.title: FIFA 10 - World Class Soccer
metadata.description:
Last year's game topped the league and now the all-new FIFA 10 is looking to defend its title as the number one football action game. More realistic than ever, this latest sequel has greatly improved artificial intelligence, ball physics and graphics.

Brand new this year is the 360 degree dribbling system, giving you the most precise control ever. There are also changes to how the defensive line is formed, as well as improvements to crosses, freekicks and goalkeepers (who can now receive red cards).

Naturally the game retains its hugely successful on and offline multiplayer modes, with new options and better stability for online play. The manager mode has also seen a massive update to make it just as deep and complex as the main game. With all these new features and more EA Sports are betting on FIFA remaining the champions for a long time to come.

metadata.title: Fifa 11 (Europe)(En,Es,Sv,No,Da)
metadata.description: FIFA 11 on Xbox 360 is a football simulation whose new features compared to the previous edition are the appearance of a creation centre and the development of Personality +, a concept that accentuates the impact of player characteristics on the way they develop. A new career mode and a new transfer system have also been implemented.

metadata.title: FIFA 11 - World Class Soccer
metadata.description:
The best-selling and most critically-acclaimed football game of all time returns for a new season -and it's still on top form. A completely new game and graphics engine brings with it a whole new level of realism and control, as well as a host of new features demanded by the fans.

The world's premier football sim goes up a league
Create your own custom chants to play online
Players are modelled more realistically than ever
Fight for possession with the new 360 degree collisions
The FIFA games are already renowned for their depth and accuracy but the new Pro Passing controls bring the onscreen action even closer to the real thing. Combined with improved man-to-man interactions this not only looks like football it plays like it too, with all its subtlety and intricacy.

It's not just the on-pitch action that's been improved though, as the new career mode ensures the most comprehensive player manager simulation ever seen in a sports game. With new player models and body types, new customisations options and new online modes this is the ultimate version of the ultimate football game.

metadata.title: Fifa 12 (Europe)(De,It,Hu)
metadata.description:
FIFA 12 brings to the pitch the game-changing new Player Impact Engine, a physics engine built to deliver real-world physicality in every interaction on the pitch.

Revolutionary gameplay innovations inspired by the real-world of soccer make FIFA Soccer 12 deeper and more engaging. All-new Precision Dribbling delivers a higher fidelity of touch on the ball for attacking players, while Tactical Defending fundamentally changes the approach to defending by placing equal importance on positioning, intercepting passes and tackling.

metadata.title: Fifa 12 (Japan)
metadata.description:
FIFA 12 brings to the pitch the game-changing new Player Impact Engine, a physics engine built to deliver real-world physicality in every interaction on the pitch.

Revolutionary gameplay innovations inspired by the real-world of soccer make FIFA Soccer 12 deeper and more engaging. All-new Precision Dribbling delivers a higher fidelity of touch on the ball for attacking players, while Tactical Defending fundamentally changes the approach to defending by placing equal importance on positioning, intercepting passes and tackling.

metadata.title: Fifa 13 (Brazil)(En,Pt)
metadata.description: Fifa 13 is a football simulation for Xbox 360. The game is even more realistic in terms of ball physics, collisions, player intelligence and the way technical moves are executed. Game modes such as Career Mode have been enhanced. It is now possible to interact with the Kinect voice recognition system.

metadata.title: FIFA 13 - World Class Soccer
metadata.description:
FIFA 13 captures the drama and unpredictability of real-world football. The game creates a true battle for possession across the entire pitch, delivers freedom and creativity in attack, and connects fans to the heartbeat of the sport - and to each other - through EA SPORTS Football Club. FIFA 13 features five breakthrough gameplay innovations which revolutionize artificial intelligence, dribbling, ball control and physical play, as well as engaging online features and live services.

FIFA 13 with Kinect enables you to use voice commands to manage your club’s line-up and tactics without pausing the game, shout directions on the pitch in Be A Pro, and forces you to temper the way you talk to officials.

metadata.title: Fifa 14 (Brazil)(En,Pt)
metadata.description: Experience the emotion of scoring great goals in FIFA 14. The game plays the way great soccer matches are contested, with innovations to the award-winning gameplay that inspire fans to build play through midfield, dictating the tempo of a match. Feel the tension as chances are created, and experience the thrill of hitting the back of the net. A new feature called Pure Shot and a brand-new ball physics system will transform shooting, making every shot attempt feel real, and when players connect with the perfect strike, feel exhilarating. FIFA 14 delivers engaging online features and live services that connect fans to the heartbeat of the sport - and to each other - through EA SPORTS Football Club. FIFA 14 is soccer's social network, where fans connect, compete and share with millions of others around the world.

metadata.title: Fifa 15 (Brazil)(En,Pt)
metadata.description: Play traditional 11 versus 11 matches with over 500 officially licensed clubs or free your game on the streets in 5 versus 5 street matches. Complete and earn awards in every game mode. Unlock the most coveted players to form your own dream club of international superstars or take on over 100 challenges to build your very own FIFA City. Earn buildings and infrastructure, better players, passionate fans, and grow your city into one of the world's most desirable places to play. Plus, experience the deepest and most engaging Manager Mode ever created for FIFA for the Wii. Compete as team manager with the power to take your favorite club to the top of the league tables - and keep them there!

metadata.title: Fifa 16 (Australia)(En,Fr,Nl)
metadata.description: FIFA 16 is a football simulation game published by EA. A reference for many gamers for many years, the title is back in 2016 with a new version scheduled for the second quarter.

metadata.title: FIFA 17 (Brazil)(En,Pt)
metadata.description: Powered by Frostbite, FIFA 17 transforms the way you play, compete, and emotionally connect with the game. FIFA 17 immerses you in authentic football experiences by leveraging the sophistication of a new game engine, while introducing you to football players full of depth and emotion, and taking you to brand new worlds accessible only in the game. Complete innovation in the way players think and move, physically interact with opponents, and execute in attack lets you own every moment on the pitch.

metadata.title: FIFA 18 - Legacy Edition
metadata.description: An update of kits and squads that aims to reflect the latest changes that have occurred in the world of football. The Legacy Editions do not include any new gameplay features or innovations.

metadata.title: FIFA 19 - Legacy Edition
metadata.description: FIFA 19 Legacy Edition launched on September 28th on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360, featuring the latest kits, clubs, and squads from top leagues around the world. Gameplay features and modes have parity with FIFA 18 and FIFA 17 for these platforms.

metadata.description: FIFA Street 3 on Xbox 360 is a street football game. The game's new design is cartoonish and almost cartoonish in appearance, and you can win all the tournaments in the game with a series of tricks and victories.

metadata.title: Coupe Du Monde De La Fifa 2006 (Europe)(Es,It)
metadata.description: Ah, l'Allemagne. Sa bière, ses belles femmes, sa coupe du monde de football 2006... C'est bien là que vous entraîne Coupe du Monde de la FIFA 2006 sur Xbox 360. A vous le choix entre une pléthore de sélections nationales pour atteindre le trophée suprême. Qualifications, phase finale et défis mondiaux sont bien entendu au rendez-vous.

metadata.title: Fight Night Champion (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: Fight Night Champion is a boxing game for Xbox 360. Play as a variety of boxers, from Filipino Manny Pacquiao to Briton Ricky Hatton. The game features free-to-play fights, online multiplayer, a fully scripted Champion mode and a Career mode where you can create your own boxer and improve each of his moves over 20 levels.

metadata.title: Fight Night : Round 3 (Asia)
metadata.description: Fight Night: Round 3 on Xbox 360 is a boxing game that pits you against the world's biggest boxing stars. Various game modes are available (big punch challenge, quick match, ESPN challenge...) and the fights are in 15 rounds. Protect your flanks to win each fight.

metadata.title: Fight Night : Round 4 (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De)
metadata.description: Fight Night: Round 4 is a boxing game for Xbox 360 that allows you to play as the most powerful fighters of all time, such as Mike Tyson and Muhammad Ali. The animations are based on improved physics recreating a wide variety of punches, blocks and movements in the ring. Fatigue, adrenaline, footwork and timing must all be mastered if victory is to be achieved.

metadata.title: Fighters Uncaged (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: Fighters Uncaged on Xbox 360 is a Thai boxing-inspired fighting game that is controlled entirely by Kinect. The player engages in a series of fights using movements recognised by the console and it is also possible to use voice commands to throw combos.

metadata.title: Final Fantasy XIII (Japan)(Disc 1)
metadata.description: Final Fantasy XIII is a console role-playing video game developed and published by Square Enix for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. Released in 2009 in Japan and North America and PAL regions in March 2010, it is the thirteenth major installment in the Final Fantasy series. The game includes fast-paced combat, a new system for the series for determining which abilities are developed for the characters called "Crystarium", and a customizable "Paradigm" system to control which abilities are used by the characters. Final Fantasy XIII includes elements from the previous games in the series, such as summoned monsters, chocobos, and airships.

metadata.title: Final Fantasy 13-2 (Europe)
metadata.description: XIII-2 begins three years after the end of XIII. Owing to the fall of Cocoon at the end of XIII and the collapse of its government (the Sanctum), at the start of XIII-2, most of Cocoon's inhabitants have moved down onto Gran Pulse, and some have learned magical abilities. Over the course of the game, a scientific body called the Academy becomes a new technocratic government. While the game starts off in the year 3 AF ('AF' being a new timescale set up after the fall of Cocoon), the story of XIII-2 jumps around several different time periods, and even parallel versions of different places, accessed via the Historia Crux. While most of the game takes place on Gran Pulse and inside Cocoon, there are two other major locations. One is the Void Beyond, a limbo between time periods. The other location is Valhalla, the capital of the goddess Etro. This place is a realm at the end of time where the goddess keeps a dark energy called chaos from escaping and destroying the timeline.

metadata.title: Football Manager 2006 (Europe)(En,Fr,Es,It)
metadata.description: Football Manager 2006 for Xbox 360 puts you on the other side of the spotlight, in the middle of contracts, transfers and big money. Manage an entire football team, from the allocation of training to the price of their socks. The whole management aspect is of the utmost importance and you'll have to handle everything with a masterful hand to gain respect in the business.

metadata.title: Football Manager 2007 (Europe)(En,Fr,Es,It)
metadata.description: Football Manager 2007 is now available on Xbox 360 for more management, scheming and football coaching. Players have the opportunity to get behind the scenes of their club's management, while being able to rely on the support and advice of their staff. Buy your players, investigate them beforehand, sell them, gain access to international positions and become the best in your field.

metadata.title: Football Manager 2008 (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Football Manager 2008 is a management game that puts you in the shoes of a coach. It offers the opportunity to practice this profession in one of the leagues of 50 different countries and, for the first time, benefits from the real licences for Ligue 1 and Ligue 2 in France. This Xbox 360 version also allows up to 16 players to compete on the same machine and up to 8 users to participate in seasons and tournaments on Xbox Live.

Developed principally by British games developer Playground Games in association with Turn 10 Studios, the game is a part of Turn 10's long-running Forza Motorsport franchise, but is considered more of a spin-off instead of the next true member of the series.

metadata.title: Forza Horizon 2 (Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt,Zh,Pl,Ru)
metadata.description: Forza Horizon 2 will take place in southern Europe and will feature hundreds of cars to drive, including the 2014 Lamborghini Huracán, which is the cover car for the game. The Xbox 360 version is built on the original Forza Horizon engine, and is led by Sumo Digital.

metadata.title: Forza Motorsport 2 (Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Zh,Ko,Pl,Cs,Hu)
metadata.description: Forza Motorsport 2 is a racing game for Xbox 360. There are three main game modes: Arcade, Career and Multiplayer. There are 47 tracks in total and over 300 cars from 45 different brands. The career mode allows you to complete over 300 races in 90 different events. Forza Motorsport 2 can also be played in multiplayer mode with up to 8 players on Xbox Live.

metadata.title: Forza Motorsport 3 (Europe, Australia)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It)(Disc 1)(Play Disc)
metadata.description: Forza Motorsport 3 on Xbox 360 is a car simulation where you can drive up to 400 cars. Race through the various tracks, melt the asphalt and in the event of an accident, turn back the clock. The game also features an editor to create your own motorized rides and a video editor to film your exploits. A multiplayer mode for up to eight players is present.

metadata.title: Forza Motorsport 4 - Essentials Edition
metadata.description:
Forza Motorsport 4 is a racing video game developed by Turn 10 Studios and published by Microsoft Studios for the Xbox 360. It is the fourth installment in the Forza Motorsport series. It is the first title in the series to support the Kinect sensor alongside the traditional controller-based gameplay.

New to the series is the Autovista mode, a mode in which players can view precise details such as engine parts and interior gauges on a select number of cars. It features a partnership with BBC's Top Gear as well as its American counterpart. Jeremy Clarkson, presenter for Top Gear, provides commentary in the game's Autovista mode. Other partnerships include a two-year agreement with the American Le Mans Series (ALMS). Over 500 cars and 26 tracks are included.

The game received universal acclaim from critics. Aggregate websites GameRankings and Metacritic report scores of 90.50% and 91 out of 100, respectively. Metacritic also reports eight perfect scores from various media outlets. Critics praised the enhanced vehicle physics, updated visuals, and strong sound design. Several reviewers also gave high marks for the Forza 4 '​s Autovista mode. Some critics expressed frustration with Kinect features, and others also felt that the game was not enough of an innovation from its predecessor, Forza Motorsport 3. These critics did, however, concede that the game was a vast improvement over Forza 3.

metadata.title: Forza Motorsport 4 (Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl,Pt,Zh,Ko,Pl,Ru,Cs,Hu)(Disc 1)(Play Disc)(Rev 1)
metadata.description: Forza Motorsport 4 is a racing video game, and the fourth in the Forza Motorsport series. Like Sony's Gran Turismo franchise, Forza games are racing simulations; heavy emphasis is placed on making the cars drive and look as realistic as possible. Races are conducted on closed circuit tracks. 500 cars are featured in the core game experience, ranging from road cars to race cars.

metadata.title: Fracture (USA, Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Ko)
metadata.description: Fracture is a third-person action game for Xbox 360. The action takes place in 2161, in the heart of a war between cybernetic soldiers and genetically modified fighters. The player can alter the terrain in the various levels with destructible environments thanks to the futuristic weaponry at his disposal. This allows the player to open new passages and access elevated areas. Fracture also features a multiplayer mode capable of hosting 12 fighters at the same time.

metadata.title: Front Mission Evolved (Japan)
metadata.description: Front Mission Evolved on Xbox 360 is an action game that puts you in control of a mecha piloted by Dylan Ramsey, facing a terrorist attack in the heart of New York City in the year 2171. You can customise your mecha to give it the look and weapons of your choice so you can go into battle with the right gear.

metadata.title: Frontlines : Fuel of War (Germany)(En,De)
metadata.description: Frontlines: Fuel of War is a first-person action game for Xbox 360. The title plunges you into the middle of the oil war between the Western bloc (USA and Europe) and the Eastern bloc (Russia and China). In single or multiplayer mode, choose your class (assault, heavy assault, sniper, anti-vehicle, special forces or hand-to-hand) and go into battle.

metadata.title: Fuel (Japan)
metadata.description: Fuel is a racing game for Xbox 360 with a playing field of over 14,000 square kilometres. In an alternate present where the Earth has been ravaged by the effects of climate change, a new breed of road junkies is born. They compete in a new extreme sport for fuel. In a variety of hostile environments, the player must watch out for torrential rains, tornadoes, sandstorms, lightning and blizzards.

metadata.title: Full Auto (Japan)
metadata.description: Crumpled metal, exploding cars, speed, adrenaline and crashes are the keywords of Full Auto on Xbox 360. Choose your car from a wide range of powerful vehicles and equip it with machine guns and cannons before biting the pavement. Once on the track, there are no more rules. Thanks to the unwreck function you can go backwards. Did you take a wrong turn? Renegotiate your trajectory! Correct your mistakes in real time!

metadata.title: Fuzion Frenzy 2 (USA, Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Zh,Ko)
metadata.description: Fuzion Frenzy 2 est un party-game sur Xbox 360 vous proposant d'affronter jusqu'à 3 autres joueurs sur une quarantaine de mini-jeux différents. Tout cela lors d'un tournoi entièrement diffusé dans l'univers, et qui voit les 6 meilleurs joueurs s'affronter dans de nombreux duels, sur 7 planètes différentes. Notz que plusieurs modes de jeu permettent de varier les parties.

metadata.title: G.I. JOE: The Rise of Cobra (Europe)
metadata.description:
An elite group of soldiers must fight against the diabolical Cobra Commander and stop his organization known as Cobra from taking over the world.
nnThe gameplay is similar to Neo Contra with a behind the back view where the player uses a variety of weapons including machine guns and rocket launchers and the Delta 6 Accelerator Suit that makes the player invulnerable for a short period of time. Using these weapons and accessories the player must fight his way through a horde of enemies including soldiers, tanks and jet fighters, along with the standard end of level bosses.
nnThe player can choose from 12 different Joes, but only a certain set at the beginning and unlocking more for completing missions, each with their own weapon and strengths depending upon their rank, along with using various vehicles scattered throughout the stages. The game also features a two-player drop-in/drop-out co-op option that allows a friend to join a game at any time.

metadata.title: Gears of War : Judgment (Europe)(En,Es,It)
metadata.description: Gears of War: Judgment is the latest installment of the legendary franchise on the Xbox 360. Again offering a campaign fully playable in cooperation with 4 players, it is a prequel set 15 years before the first Gears of War trilogy, with the ability to unlock a bonus mission narrating events happening during the Gears 3 campaign. In Gears of War 3, players fight on as Marcus Fenix, the grizzled war hero and leader of Delta Squad. Eighteen months after the fall of the last human city, the war against the Locust rages on. Meanwhile, deep beneath the surface, a fearsome new threat is infecting the planet from within. With survivors scattered and civilization in ruins, time is running out for Marcus and his comrades as they fight to save the human race.

metadata.description: Before taking on Death Adder in the company of Ax Battler and the dwarf Gillius Thunderhead in an adventure that has become legendary, Tyris Flare was living happily on the island of Axir, where his home village is located. But a demonic attack on the local Dragon God/Titan during a ceremony in his honour led by the priestesses of Axir was not to be. The God was captured by the demon's henchmen, including 2 twins who were his henchmen, while all the priestesses perished. The dragon still had time to give her his powers of fire. Tyris finds herself embroiled in an adventure in which she must reconstitute the golden axe in order to challenge Death Adder when she finds herself on his land.

metadata.title: Golden Compass, The (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Young Lyra Belacqua, seeking to uncover the mysteries behind a string of child kidnappings, finds herself plunged into a conflict which shakes the very foundations of her world. With the help of her shape-shifting animal daemon Pan, and armored polar bear companion Iorek, her adventures take her from the rooftops of Oxford to the frozen wastes of the North.

metadata.title: Goldeneye 007 Reloaded (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: GoldenEye 007 Reloaded est un jeu de tir à la première personne sur 360. Il s'agit donc d'incarner James Bond et de s'assurer que le fameux GoldenEye, un satellite militaire extrêmement dangereux, ne tombe pas aux mains de l'ennemi. Cette version 360 n'est pas un remake direct du fameux jeu sorti sur Nintendo 64, il s'agit toutefois d'un hommage appuyé qui regorge de clins d'oeil destinés aux fans.

metadata.title: Grand Slam Tennis 2
metadata.description: Feel the true excitement and emotion of championship tennis with EA SPORTS Grand Slam Tennis 2. For the first time in HD and on the next generation platforms, experience the thrill of winning at Wimbledon and capturing all four Grand Slam tournaments. Rise to stardom with the revolutionary Total Racket Control as you challenge a deep roster of elite players, including Djokovic, Federer, Nadal, Sharapova, Borg, and McEnroe. With immersive PlayStation Move support, authentic gameplay, ESPN broadcast integration, a deep 10-year career mode and so much more, get ready to Swing the racket like a Grand Slam champion with Grand Slam Tennis 2.

metadata.title: Grand Theft Auto IV (Australia)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: The Serbian ex-soldier Niko Bellic had witnessed the horrors of war, which turned him bitter and cynical. Disappointed by life, he immigrates to the United States, which his cousin Roman enthusiastically describes as a country of wealth and pleasure. However, the reality is quite different: Roman is poor, has no stable job, and owes money to some dubious individuals. As Niko attempts to help his hapless cousin and pave a more secure future for both of them, he becomes more and more involved in the life of crime. A burning desire to find a man who had betrayed him in Serbia forces Niko to make deals with his conscience, and once he crosses the line, there is no way back...

metadata.title: Grand Theft Auto V (Japan)(Disc 1)(Install)
metadata.description:
Los Santos: a sprawling sun-soaked metropolis full of self-help gurus, starlets and fading celebrities, once the envy of the Western world, now struggling to stay afloat in an era of economic uncertainty and cheap reality TV.

Amidst the turmoil, three very different criminals plot their own chances of survival and success: Franklin, a street hustler looking for real opportunities and serious money; Michael, a professional ex-con whose retirement is a lot less rosy than he hoped it would be; and Trevor, a violent maniac driven by the chance of a cheap high and the next big score. Running out of options, the crew risks everything in a series of daring and dangerous heists that could set them up for life.

The biggest, most dynamic and most diverse open world ever created, Grand Theft Auto V blends storytelling and gameplay in new ways as players repeatedly jump in and out of the lives of the game's three lead characters, playing all sides of the game's interwoven story.

All the classic hallmarks of the groundbreaking series return, including incredible attention to detail and Grand Theft Auto's darkly humorous take on modern culture, alongside a brand new and ambitious approach to open world multiplayer.

metadata.title: Gray Matter (Europe)
metadata.description: Gray Matter est un jeu d'aventure sur Xbox 360 narrant l'histoire du neurobiologiste David Styles. Depuis la mort accidentelle de sa femme, Styles vit reclus dans sa propriété de Dread Hill House. La magicienne fauchée Samantha Everett devient son assistante. Le joueur, qui dirige alternativement les deux personnages, tente de percer les mystères de cette étrange maison.

metadata.title: Grease Dance (Europe)
metadata.description: Grease Dance est un party-game convivial sur Xbox 360 comprenant un mode Danse, un mode Karaoké et des mini-jeux. Le joueur doit reproduire des chorégraphies et chanter 15 chansons issues de la célèbre comédie musicale Grease. Cinq standards d'époque ainsi que des épreuves telles que des courses de voiture ou des combats de lutte sont également disponibles.

metadata.title: Green Day : Rock Band (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: Green Day: Rock Band for Xbox 360 is a rhythm game that traces the Berkeley punk trio's career from their edgy beginnings to concept albums. For the occasion, Rock Band is also dressed up in the band's colours.

metadata.description: In Greg Hastings Paintball 2 , create your own team of paintball warriors and take on no fewer than 60 battlefields in 12 locations. Seven game modes are available, plus online multiplayer for up to 14 fighters. The game also features Kinect functionality.

metadata.title: Race Driver : GRID (Japan)
metadata.description: Race Driver Grid on Xbox 360 puts your driving skills to the test in three different driving environments. Alternate between America and its muscle cars, Europe and its legendary models and Japan and its drifts, all in well-known cities that have been fully modelled. Beware, however, of collisions which can prove fatal. A multiplayer mode allows several players to compete online.

metadata.title: Grid 2 (Europe)(Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Be fast, be the best and be famous with the return of GRID 2, the sequel to Race Driver: GRID. Experience aggressive racing against advanced AI and immerse yourself in the race thanks to GRID 2's new TrueFeel handling system, which offers an exceptional sensation behind the wheel of each legendary vehicle. The next-generation "EGO" engine delivers incredible graphics and never-before-seen damage in races set on three continents, where you'll have to prove yourself in an ever-changing world of motorsport. Gain fame and riches by winning in intense, fast-paced races on real circuits, on faithfully reproduced streets and on mountainous roads with highly dangerous hairpins.

metadata.title: GRID : Autosport (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt,Pl,Ru)
metadata.description: Simulation de voiture et jeu de course, GRID : Autosport sur Xbox 360 permet au joueur de se mettre dans la peau d'un coureur automobile. Selon ses performances, il a accès à de nouveaux bolides et peut courir contre l'I.A. ou d'autres joueurs.

metadata.title: Guilty Gear 2 Overture (Europe)
metadata.description: Guilty Gear 2 Overture is a tactical action game that takes place in the universe of the Guilty Gear series. In the different levels, you have to collect magic blocks by summoning creatures.

metadata.title: Guitar Hero : Aerosmith (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: Guitar Hero : Aerosmith sur Xbox360 est un jeu vous permettant de vous mettre dans la peau de l'un des guitaristes du célèbre groupe à l'aide d'une guitare spécialement dédiée au jeu. Cette version se consacre au groupe Aerosmith et à l'ensemble de son oeuvre, puisque toutes les principales chansons y sont disponibles et jouables sur différents niveaux de difficulté.

metadata.title: Guitar Hero : Metallica (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Like Aerosmith before it, the band Metallica is at the centre of its own Guitar Hero game on Xbox 360. Whether behind the microphone, guitar, bass or drums, the player revisits the repertoire of the famous band. Other bands are also invited to lend a hand to the "metalheads".

metadata.title: Guitar Hero - Smash Hits
metadata.description:
Guitar Hero Smash Hits is the best of Guitar Hero music, now for the full band! Rock out to the most fun tracks from Guitar Hero, Guitar Hero II, Guitar Hero: Rock the 80's, and Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock, now for the full band. Using the controllers strum, drum, and belt out a collection of master tracks including Nirvana, Judas Priest, Slayer, Rage Against the Machine, Queen, and many more.

Titled Guitar Hero Greatest Hits in Europe and Australia.

metadata.title: Guitar Hero : Van Halen (USA)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Guitar Hero : Van Halen sur Xbox 360 est un jeu de rythme dédié au groupe de Hard Rock Américain Van Halen. Le titre propose aussi quelques morceaux de Queen, Weezer, Blink-182, The Offsprings et Queens of the Stone Age.

metadata.title: Guitar Hero : Warriors of Rock (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Guitar Hero: Warriors of Rock is a rhythm game for Xbox 360. You will have to find and free the demigod of rock from the clutches of The Beast. The Beast is a supernatural and almost invincible being who has only one Achilles heel: music. To defeat him, the player will have to gather a group of legendary musicians around him in order to pass the various tests imposed by The Beast.

metadata.title: Guitar Hero 5 (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Guitar Hero 5 sur Xbox 360 vous permet de jouer sur 85 morceaux de musique de Blink 182 à Deep Purple en passant par Bob Dylan et Elton John. Quel que soit votre instrument, en solo ou entre amis, revivez les concerts des plus grands et faites-vous aduler par la foule. Cette édition permet de rejoindre ou de quitter un morceau à la volée ou de jouer avec plusieurs instruments identiques (plusieurs batteries par exemple).

metadata.title: Guitar Hero II (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Guitar Hero II is a rhythm game for Xbox 360, allowing you, equipped with a special guitar, to become the greatest rocker of all time. The title also features a cooperative mode.

metadata.title: Gun (Germany)
metadata.description: Gun sur Xbox 360 est un jeu d'action à la sauce cow-boys, western et indiens. Incarnez Coton White et vengez-vous de tous ceux qui vous ont trahi. Retrouvez de nombreuses armes et un paquet de défis dans des niveaux regorgeant de coyotes prêts à vous faire la peau. De plus, profitez d'un mode multi proposant de nombreux jeux en partie rapide et trois modes distincts : deathmatch, croix dorée et poker.

metadata.title: Gundam Musou 2
metadata.description: Dynasty Warriors: Gundam 2 combines the devastating power of the mobile suit, the rich legacy of the anime Gundam universe, and the furious tactical action gameplay of the Dynasty Warriors series. For the first time, engage in melee battles against colossal enemies such as the Psycho Gundam who can quickly reconfigure their bodies into titanic mobile fortresses. Prepare to head off into the furthest reaches of space and wage war against legions of enemy mobile suits.

metadata.title: Gundam Musou 3
metadata.description: First released in December 2008, the Dynasty Warriors: Gundam series has gained much popularity, and finally the newest entry is going to be released soon. By continuing all of the popular elements and loosing unpopular elements of the previous installments, we hope that this installment is the best of the series. With newly added features to set this installment apart from the rest, it has evolved to increase the player's sense of "an authentic battlefield experience."

metadata.title: Gunstringer, The (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: The Gunstringer is a shooting and platforming game for the Xbox 360 compatible with the famous Kinect motion sensor. Controlling a cowboy puppet with his left hand, the player uses his right hand as a gun to shoot anything that moves. Numerous enemies and fearsome bosses set in original settings will give us a lot of trouble throughout a fresh and dynamic adventure.

metadata.title: Hail To The Chimp (USA)
metadata.description: Hail to the Chimp sur Xbox 360 est un party game dans lequel les joueurs incarnent l'un des dix animaux disponibles en piste pour le titre de Roi de la Jungle (sur la même console ou online). Centré sur une série de mini-jeux, le soft propose également une dimension politique originale, avec campagne électorale, alliances de circonstance et trahisons.

metadata.title: Halo Combat Evolved Anniversaire (World)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt,Zh,Ko)
metadata.description:
Halo: Combat Evolved Anniversary is a re-release of Halo: Combat Evolved for the Xbox 360, intended to celebrate the tenth anniversary of the Halo series.

The anniversary edition comes with the same single player campaign, the only difference being that the player can switch between the graphics engine used in the original Combat Evolved (for identical graphics to the original), or switch to the same graphics engine used in Halo: Reach (for more modern graphics) at any point during the campaign, even mid session. The campaign also supports co operative gameplay.

The multiplayer portion of the game has all the same maps featured in the original as well as several new ones, and like the single player, players can switch between the classic and modern graphics at any point during the session. The multiplayer has also been enhanced with some of the features from the more recent Halo games including emblems, weapon loadouts, customisable armour and selectable gender.

metadata.title: Halo Reach (Brazil)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt,Zh,Ko)
metadata.description: Halo Reach on Xbox 360 tells the story of the fall of the planet Reach, before the very first episode of the famous FPS series. It follows the desperate fight of the Noble squad of powerful Spartans against the countless Covenant legions. The campaign is playable in 4 player co-op and the game features a multitude of highly configurable multiplayer modes, including the popular Baptism of Fire. A comprehensive map editor is also included.

metadata.title: Halo 3 (Asia)(En,Zh)
metadata.description: Master Chief returns to a Covenant Dominated Earth on a mission to kill the final alien leader. Meanwhile, the Arbiter, Johnson, and Keyes form a loose alliance and escape from Delta Halo. The Covenant is ripped in civil war, and the Elites along with a handful of other alien races become sympathetic to the human cause. Delta Halo's impromptu dis-activation has brought all of the Halos to a "remote activation phase". They can be activated from a facility called the ark, which happens to be on Earth.

metadata.title: Halo 3 : ODST (Asia)(Campaign)
metadata.description: Halo 3: ODST happens mostly at the same time of the events of Halo 2 and the very beginning of Halo 3. It details the Covenant's invasion to Earth in year 2552 from the point of view of the Orbital Drop Shock Troopers. The player takes the role of various members of the ODST squad in the war-torn city of New Mombasa - most prominently The Rookie, who can be considered the protagonist of the game.

metadata.title: Halo 4 (Brazil)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl,Pt,No,Da,Fi,Zh,Ko,Pl,Ru)(Disco 1)
metadata.description: Master Chief re-emerges to battle an ancient evil force determined to wreak vengeance and annihilation. Shipwrecked on a mysterious world, faced with new enemies and deadly technology, the universe won't ever be the same. Enlist aboard the Infinity to experience Halo's original multiplayer (with up to three cohorts) and Spartan Ops - innovative episodic fiction-based co-op missions. Go Beyond the Story: Halo 4's Infinity Multiplayer features an expanded suite of multiplayer modes, weapons, vehicles, armor abilities, a new loadout and Spartan IV player progression system.

metadata.title: Halo Wars (Europe, Australia)(En,Es,Pl,Cs,Hu)

Join the Spirit of Fire crew in their battle against the Covenant alien coalition and prepare to command entire armies of Spartans, warthogs and more. Elle va alors vivre une histoire pleine de rencontres, qui suit la trame du film. Mais elle n'oublie pas son métier de chanteuse pour autant, puisque le jeu réserve quelques phases de karaoké.

metadata.title: Happy Feet 2 (USA, Europe)

metadata.title: History Legends of War (Europe)
metadata.description: History Legends of War: Patton is a turn-based strategy game and the follow-up to Legends of War: Patton's Campaign. The game puts you in control of General Patton's army during World War II. Players can go through the whole war, from Belgium to the beaches of France. A small unit of army men is guided as they battle through 21 unique missions. There are four different styles of missions: Attack, Defense, Infiltration, and Sabotage. Attack involves simply eliminating the enemies units, while defense involves resisting enemy attacks over a set number of turns. Infiltration involves completing various missions with your infantrymen while going undetected by enemy units, with Sabotage being the opposite.

metadata.title: Hitman Absolution (France)
metadata.description: Hitman : Absolution on Xbox 360 is an Infiltration game in which we find an Agent 47 as meticulous and efficient as ever. As always, his contracts will take him to the four corners of the globe and this time will allow him to settle his inner conflicts.

metadata.title: Hitman : Blood Money (Germany)
metadata.description: Hitman: Blood Money on Xbox 360 features Agent 47 in an action/infiltration game. You are a hitman in charge of eliminating your targets with the utmost discretion. Blend into the background, find the quietest way to your target and do what you do best: kill. You can use any means to achieve your goal.

metadata.title: Hitman : HD Trilogy (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De)(Disc 1)
metadata.description:
Hitman HD Trilogy bundles three games in the Hitman series that have been remastered for this trilogy release along with the promotional Sniper Challenge game that came as a pre-order for Hitman: Absolution. Except for Hitman: Blood Money on the Xbox 360, none of the included titles were previously available on the platforms. The package includes:

    Hitman 2: Silent Assassinnn    Hitman: Contractsnn    Hitman: Blood Moneynn    Hitman: Sniper Challenge

metadata.title: Hokuto Musou
metadata.description: Prepare for the merciless action and violent hand to hand combat of Fist of the North Star: Ken's Rage! Put your martial arts skills to the test against masses of bloodthirsty enemies in this no-holds-barred brawler. A ravaged Earth struggles to survive after the nuclear holocaust has left the world in ruins. Pitiful survivors band together in communities and villages, trying to live on what little resources they have left. In the wastelands beyond, vicious gangs prey on the survivors for their resources, or sometimes just for fun. A mysterious martial artist named Kenshiro, a man with seven scars on his chest and the chosen successor of the legendary assassin's art Hokuto Shinken (The Divine Fist of the North Star) has sworn to protect the weak and innocent from the malicious gangs that roam the scorched planet.

metadata.title: Hot Wheels : Beat That ! (Europe)(Fr,De,It)
metadata.description: Choose your car, grab the wheel, and send Mattel's miniature machines racing with Hot Wheels: Beat That! Players can choose from 30 awesome cars authentically modeled from the design specs of official Hot Wheels car models as they compete against friends or the computer AI on an assortment of tracks that run through bedrooms, backyards, and similar neighborhood settings. Each course offers multiple loops, drop-offs, ramps, and jumps, as players race across multiple laps in a variety of life-sized environments to make it first across the finish line!

metadata.title: Hot Wheels - World's Best Driver
metadata.description: Gear up for intense challenges only Hot Wheels can deliver! Join the ranks of Team Hot Wheels, an elite group of drivers competing for the coveted title: “World’s Best Driver.” The drivers are split into four teams, each with their own disciplines: Super Fast (Green), Outrageous (Red), High-Tech (Blue) and Powerful (Yellow). Compete in thrilling events across four Hot Wheels Test Facility (HWTF) locations around the world. For the first time, Hot Wheels fans can experience the legendary world of HWTF where the latest and greatest Hot Wheels creations are born. Pick your team, choose your ride and GO FOR IT!

metadata.title: Hunted : The Demon's Forge (Europe)(Fr,De,Es,It)

Le tandem de choc est constitué d'Elara une elfe spécialiste des armes à distance et de Caddock, guerrier au corps-à-corps. Le jeu est jouable à deux et l'on peut interchanger les personnages à volonté.
