metadata.title: Idolmaster, The - Live for You!
metadata.description: The Idolmaster Live For You! is a Japanese live simulation video game in The Idolmaster series and a sequel to The Idolmaster. The gameplay in Live For You! focuses on coordinating the concert event from The Idolmaster with higher customization of the songs, stage and costumes. The game features a rhythm minigame during performances, which was developed to add a sense of unity with the audience and add excitement. The player is also able to freely manipulate how the performance looks by adjusting the position of the camera towards the idols. The story is told from the perspective of a special producer in charge of coordinating the live performances of 11 pop idols from The Idolmaster series. Including downloadable content, the game features 74 songs the idols perform: 32 songs in original versions and 42 remixes of those songs, which have been released on several music albums.

metadata.title: Ihf Handball Challenge 14 (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,Sv,Da)
metadata.description: IHF Handball Challenge 14 is a handball sports game and the second in the series as the follow-up to IHF Handball Challenge 12. As a licensed game it offers 80 clubs for the 2013-2014 season for the leagues Ligue Nationale de Handball (France), DKB Handball-Bundesliga (Germany) and Liga ASOBAL (Spain), as well as 30 national teams, and live commentary in three languages (German, French and English). Players can also create their own leagues, players, and teams, and build a career for an entirely new player. It is possible to design custom tournaments and player with up to four players simultaneously.

metadata.title: IL-2 Sturmovik : Birds of Prey (Germany)
metadata.description: IL-2 Sturmovik: Birds of Prey is the Xbox 360 adaptation of the popular PC aircraft simulation series. The player visualises the damage his plane takes (holes in the wings, smoke trails) during frenzied battles, in a World War II atmosphere. The arcade and simulation modes allow you to adjust the degree of realism.

metadata.title: Incredible Hulk, The (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Bruce Banner lands with a bang on Xbox 360 and he's not happy. So he turns into the Hulk. The Incredible Hulk features the green giant with the rip-stop pants and offers a storyline that follows the feature film of the same name while offering new passages, all in a mostly destructible environment for a 100% brutal action game guaranteed with GMOs.

metadata.title: Indianapolis 500 Evolution (USA)
metadata.description: Indianapolis 500 Evolution is a racing game for Xbox 360. Set in the sixties, you have to build your own cars and race them on the most famous tracks of American car racing: Milwaukee Mile, Trenton, Langhorne Speedway... You can also compete against the greatest drivers of the time.

metadata.title: Infernal : Hell's Vengeance (Japan)
metadata.description:
Ryan Lennox is technically dead but still he remains on earth and works for the heavenly organization EtherLight. But also Ryan does a pretty good job, his boss doesn't approve of his not-so-heavenly-methods. So he fires him and puts an assassin on his tail. After the failed murder-attempt, Lennox gets hired by Lazarus, boss of the Abyss - the natural enemy of EtherLight. EtherLight had killed all of his agents and now prepares the final blow to get rid of Abyss once and for all. Ryan now, under the guidance of Black, needs to prevent this from happening.

Black gives Ryan for that task a few powers like teleportation, telekinesis or a way to make his shots more powerful. But those actions require mana and since Lennox is now a creature of the dark and evil, he needs either to stay in the shadows or convict sins (like killing the EtherLight agents) in order for his mana to regenerate.

metadata.title: Infinite Undiscovery (Asia)(Disc 1)
metadata.description:
Infinite Undiscovery is an RPG set in a magical world where an evil army called the Order of the Chains, led by the Dreadknight, has ensnared the life giving moon by using giant chains to lock it into place. As a result of these chains, the moon has become corrupted, with its powers creating powerful and grotesque monsters loose on the world as crops and life begins to wither and die.

The player takes control of a young boy named Capell, who is captured by the Order and put in their dark prison. After a few days, a young female warrior named Aya frees him and brings him to the leader of her group of warriors named Sigmund is looks remarkably like Capell. They band together and set out to free the moon and bring their world back from the brink of chaos.

metadata.title: Injustice - Gods Among Us
metadata.description: What if our greatest heroes became our greatest threat? Injustice: Gods Among Us introduces a bold new franchise to the fighting game genre from NetherRealm Studios, creators of the definitive fighting game Mortal Kombat. Featuring DC Comics icons such Batman, Cyborg, The Flash, Harley Quinn, Nightwing, Solomon Grundy, Superman and Wonder Woman, the latest title from the award-winning studio presents a deep original story. Heroes and villains will engage in epic battles on a massive scale in a world where the line between good and evil has been blurred.

metadata.description: International Cricket 2010 is a sports game for Xbox 360 based on cricket. A sport that is little known in France but very popular in the UK. For the occasion, Codemasters has brought together the majority of the most influential leagues' licences. You control a cricket team, with a 360° camera that allows you to direct the game and its tactical choices. A multiplayer mode is also included.

metadata.title: Inversion (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Inversion est un jeu d'action sur Xbox 360 qui vous propose de jongler avec les principes de la gravité. Muni d'un grappin capable de manipuler la physique, vous pouvez vous frayer un chemin en lançant toutes sortes d'objets sur vos ennemis et dans le décor. Ces éléments pourront également vous servir de bouclier. Jouable en mode coopératif Inversion vous propose un arsenal d'armes gravitationnelles très complet et vous projette dans un futur proche en guerre.

metadata.title: Iron Man (USA)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description:
Mostly based on the 2008 movie Iron Man, this videogame of the one-man-army hero has been released for seven different platforms.

The game of Iron Man puts you under the skin of Tony Stark. He is a billionaire weapon-industrialist and genius inventor who, after being kidnapped by terrorists who want to force him to build weapons for them, builds an armor instead to escape. Since then, he decided to stop producing weapons and keeps on working on the suit to fight them back.

The games take the story further, giving the player the chance to go through more than 12 different missions and even fight villains that do not appear on the movie, like Whiplash and Titanium Man.

metadata.title: Iron Man 2 (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description:
Iron Man 2 is a tie-in release to the 2010 film of the same name. The game's story (written by comics writer Matt Fraction) takes place after the film and sees Tony "Iron Man" Stark and James "War Machine" Rhodes team up to defeat a coalition of American and Russian terrorists that plan on duplicating Tony's technology for their own sinister purposes, resulting in versions of the comic villains Crimson Dynamo and Ultimo.

The game is a third-person action game consisting of eight missions. Players control both Iron Man and War Machine - some levels predetermine which character is controlled, others allow players to select. Both characters differ in their abilities: Iron Man is more agile and has energy weapons, while War Machine has better armor and relies on ballistic weapons. Both also have a unique power usable only once per mission: Iron Man can become invincible while War Machine can boost the power of his weapons, both only for a limited time. The levels throw a multitude of enemies at the two, including drones, robots, tanks and helicopters.

metadata.title: Jackbox Party Pack, The
metadata.description:
The team behind "You Don't Know Jack" presents five guffaw-inducing party games in one pack! You're gonna need more than one party for this. Your phones or tablets are your controllers! For 1-100 players! Games include:
- You Don't Know Jack 2015, the trivia comedy sensation with hundreds of all-new questions. (1-4 players)
- Fibbage XL, the hilarious bluffing game with over 50% more questions added to the original hit game Fibbage. (2-8 players)
- Drawful, the bizarre drawing game—you draw right there on your phone or tablet (very little/no real skill required). (3-8 players)
- Word Spud, the racy-as-you-want-to-be fill-in-the-blank word game. (2-8 players)
- The wacky-fact-filled Lie Swatter. (1-100 players)

metadata.title: James Cameron's Avatar : The Game (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: James Cameron's Avatar: The Game for Xbox 360 is an action game directly adapted from the film of the same name. The game allows you to explore the mysterious jungle of the planet Pandora where the Na'vis, an alien race with blue skin, live. Soon, however, you'll have to choose sides and fight as a human soldier or as a Na'vi. A multiplayer mode with up to 16 players is also available.

metadata.title: JASF : Jane's Advanced Strike Fighters (USA)
metadata.description: Jane's Advanced Strike Fighters for Xbox 360 takes us into a fictional civil war in the heart of Azbaristan. The player can take control of 30 different aircraft to complete 16 missions in a territory of 65,000 square kilometres. Multiplayer modes accommodate up to 16 participants in versus and four participants in co-op.

metadata.title: Jillian Michaels Fitness Adventure (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Jillian Michaels' Fitness Adventure invites us this time to move our bodies exclusively on Xbox 360. Thanks to Kinect's advanced motion detection, the famous coach will be able to take us on a real expedition through the jungle while we do various series of exercises designed to keep us in shape.

metadata.description: Jimmie Johnson's Anything with an Engine on Xbox 360 is a racing game in which the player pilots cobbled-together machines equipped with super-powerful engines. You will have to master the device to drive through circuits filled with obstacles and jumps.

metadata.title: Stranglehold (Europe, Australia)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Stranglehold is an action game for Xbox 360. You play as Chow Yun-Fat, aka Tequila, a Hong Kong policeman, during seven different missions. Between honour, love, betrayal and revenge, use the weapons at your disposal to annihilate the countless masses of enemies who want your skin. It is also possible to use "Tequila Time", which is based on Bullet Time.

metadata.title: Juiced 2 : Hot Import Nights (Australia)(Demo)
metadata.description: Juiced 2: HIN evolves the current street racing scene, letting players experience the culture of the real-life HIN tour, the nation's largest lifestyle custom car show in an intense racing experience. Featuring track and drift racing at real-world locations around the globe, next-gen AI and vehicle customization, Juiced 2: HIN brings street racing to life, allowing players to test their skills at live street racing events against a back-drop of DJs, fashion, models and musicians. New features include addictive drift/ powersliding races and "Driver DNA" that tracks gamers' personal driving traits.

metadata.title: Jumper : Griffin's Story (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: Jumper: Griffin's Story is the Xbox 360 video game adaptation of the film Jumper. You play as Griffin, one of the Jumpers who has the power to teleport, pursued by the Paladins who are desperate to exterminate those with this power. Escape from the organisation and fight against numerous enemies. Take revenge on your belligerents and restore your family's image.

metadata.title: Jurassic : The Hunted (USA)
metadata.description: Jurassic: The Hunted on Xbox 360 is a first-person shooter that puts the player in the shoes of Craig Dylan, a weapons and survival expert hired by a team of scientists. Following an accident, he is thrown back in time and finds himself alone in the distant past, confronted by a bunch of unsociable dinosaurs. It's up to you to survive with the help of a very substantial arsenal.

metadata.title: Jurassic Park : The Game (USA)
metadata.description: Jurassic Park: The Game is an action-adventure game download for Xbox 360 that takes place alongside the Jurassic Park movie. The game puts you in the shoes of new characters who must survive the hell of the famous park. The only objective is to get off the island in one piece.

metadata.title: Just Cause (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: In Just Cause, an explosive action game for Xbox 360, you are Rick Rodriguez, a top secret agent on the verge of revolution. Choose from one hundred vehicles (helicopters, boats, motorbikes, mini-submarines, planes and cars) as you explore the 1,024 square kilometres of the tropical island of San Esperito!

metadata.title: Just Cause 2 (Japan)
metadata.description: The character of Rico Rodriguez is back in Just Cause 2 on Xbox 360, a fast-paced action game set in the Asian islands of Panau and offering 1,000 square kilometres to explore in a variety of vehicles. A wide range of weapons are available to carry out your missions, which you can complete with stunts. Use the parachute and grappling hook to get out of dangerous situations, ensuring your survival in hostile environments.

metadata.title: Just Dance : Disney Party (USA)
metadata.description: Just Dance: Disney Party is an Xbox 360 dance game for youngsters. Up to 4 players can compete by dancing to 25 well-known songs in French or in various other languages (English, Italian, Swedish...). Several game modes are available to party and a special section is available for parents.

metadata.title: Just Dance 2014 (Europe)
metadata.description: Just Dance 2014 is a rhythm game available on Xbox 360. The player has to sway to the beat by following the choreographies shown on the screen. Up to 4 players can dance together or compete against players from all over the world in the World Dancefloor mode.

metadata.title: Just Dance 2015 (Europe)
metadata.description: Just Dance 2015 is a rhythm game for Xbox 360 in which players can dance to tracks such as Happy by Pharrell Williams, the Macarena or Free from the Snow Queen. It is possible to dance asynchronously against players from all over the world, especially against stars, or to share your videos in order to be featured in community videos.

metadata.title: Just Dance 2017
metadata.description: Grab your friends and family: it’s time to dance! Just Dance is back with over 40 new tracks, 6 games modes, and ever more songs through Just Dance Unlimited subscription service! Featuring the ultimate tracklist including Cheap Thrills by Sia Ft. Sean Paul, Sorry by Justin Bieber and many more!

metadata.title: Just Dance 2018 (Europe)
metadata.description: In Just Dance, players learn real dance moves to songs they know and love across a wide genre of music over the past sixty years. Requiring only one Wii Remote per player, up to four people can break it down at a time, as they follow on-screen choreographed moves set to classic dance tracks, covering a wide variety of musical genres and bringing everyone to the dance floor.

metadata.title: Just Dance 2019 (USA)
metadata.description: In Just Dance, players learn real dance moves to songs they know and love across a wide genre of music over the past sixty years. Requiring only one Wii Remote per player, up to four people can break it down at a time, as they follow on-screen choreographed moves set to classic dance tracks, covering a wide variety of musical genres and bringing everyone to the dance floor.

metadata.title: Just Dance 3 (Europe)
metadata.description: Just Dance 3 is a dance game for Xbox 360 using the Kinect peripheral of the console. Dance solo, in duets or in quartets to your favourite hits. This Xbox 360 version allows you to create and share your own choreographies.

metadata.title: Just Dance 4 (Europe)(Rev 1)
metadata.description: Just Dance 4 on Xbox 360 is a dance game in which you have to reproduce the indicated movements with the help of the console's Kinect device. Songs such as Disturbia by Rihanna, Good Feeling by Flo Rida, Super Bass by Nicki Minaj and You're the first, the last, my everything by Barry White are featured in this game, which contains a total of 40 songs.

metadata.title: Just Dance Kids (Europe)
metadata.description: Just Dance Kids is a user-friendly dance game for Xbox 360. Using the Kinect motion sensor, one or two players must try to reproduce the movements of the dancers visible on the screen. About forty songs are available with titles as varied as "Frères Jacques", "Love Me" or "Whip my Hair".

metadata.title: Kameo : Elements of Power (Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Zh,Ko)(Rev 1)
metadata.description: Kameo: Elements of Power for Xbox 360 is an action-adventure game in which you play as a being capable of transforming into almost anything. Assume the power of your inner warriors to fly to the rescue of your Elemental Ancestors and eliminate Thorn, the evil king of the Trolls.

metadata.title: Kane & Lynch : Dead Men (Japan)
metadata.description: In the action game Kane & Lynch: Dead Men for Xbox 360, we follow the trials and tribulations of Marcus Adam, aka Kane, sentenced to death for the murder of 25 Venezuelans and recently escaped from prison thanks to the intervention of James Seth Lynch, an ultra-violent psychopath. It's up to you to play as these two characters during the 16 chapters of the Adventure mode.

metadata.title: Kane & Lynch 2 : Dog Days (Germany)
metadata.description: Kane & Lynch 2: Dog Days on Xbox 360 is a third person action game in which you play as two criminals (Kane or Lynch) in the heart of Shanghai. In a dark and bloody atmosphere, you must carry out various robberies and other crimes not always with finesse. The design of the game is inspired by documentary films shot on camera.

metadata.title: Karaoke Revolution (USA)
metadata.description: Karaoke Revolution is a singing game for Xbox 360. Do you like to sing? You can choose from a range of songs in this karaoke game. As always, look at the lyrics on the screen and modulate your voice according to the pitch indicated. Moreover, you can create your avatar and give it a particular style: hip-hop, metal, disco, etc...

metadata.title: Karaoke Revolution Glee - Volume 3
metadata.description: Get ready to ’gleek out’ like never before with the McKinley High GLEE Club in Karaoke Revolution Glee: Volume 3! The hit franchise returns with the largest lineup of all-new show hits and music performancesto date. Karaoke Revolution Glee; Volume 3 boasts over 35 chart-topping tunes, filled with the show’s main characters, guest stars, and show-stopping performances from Season 2! Put yourself at center stage and experience the GLEE phenomenon!

Grab the mics and challenge your friends to find out who will be the next superstar and face the music as Simon Cowell, Paula Abdul and Randy Jackson critique your performances.

After the events of the first movie the self-proclaimed Kick-Ass superhero is largely by himself. His sidekick Hit Girl lost her father Big Daddy and has to live with a friend called Marcus. Now Kick-Ass roams the streets by himself, bringing villains to justice, while Hit Girl promised to abandon her old ways. She now stays in contact with Kick-Ass through her phone and does not fight along with him. Eventually Kick-Ass will join the band of superheroes called Justice Forever.

metadata.title: Killer Is Dead (Europe)
metadata.description: Killer is Dead is an action game for Xbox 360. You play as Mondo, a hitman in charge of eliminating the Wires, monsters coming directly from the dark side of the Moon. Mondo is also a real charmer who never misses an opportunity to pick up pretty girls who can provide him with new weapons.

metadata.title: Kinect Adventures ! (Asia)(En,Zh)
metadata.description: Kinect Adventures! is a party game for Xbox 360. The game uses Kinect, the accessory that directly recognises the player's movements. The title features five activities: ride down rapids on an inflatable boat, dive underwater in a glass cage, hit balls to destroy a wall, avoid obstacles on a wagon and blow bubbles in zero gravity.

metadata.title: Kinect Disneyland Adventures (Japan)
metadata.description: Kinect Disneyland Adventures invites you to explore Disney's Californian park and experience 18 legendary attractions (Space Mountain, Pirates of the Caribbean, etc.) while meeting some thirty famous characters (Mickey, Goofy, Arielle, etc.). In total, 100 mini-games and challenges await players who can experience this adventure alone or in cooperation.

metadata.title: Kinect Joy Ride (USA, Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt,Zh,Ko,Pl,Ru)
metadata.description: Kinect Joy Ride on Xbox 360 is a crazy free car racing game where you can use your Xbox Live avatars to drive your own cars, which you can customize to your heart's content! The game is more multiplayer oriented, allowing you to play live and share content. The atmosphere is very cartoony, a la Roadrunner and Coyote, in settings inspired by the Grand Canyon.

metadata.title: Kinect Star Wars (Europe)
metadata.description: Kinect Star Wars on Xbox 360 is an action game using the Kinect peripheral. The software offers 5 distinct game modes: the main one allows you to follow a young padawan in a scripted campaign and the others offer pod races, destruction sequences in the skin of a rancor, galactic dance sessions and duels against emblematic characters of the saga. A co-op mode for two is also included.

metadata.title: Kinectimals (World)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl,Pt,Zh,Ko,Pl,Ru)
metadata.description: Kinectimals is an animal simulation for Xbox 360. Using the Kinect accessory, the player can communicate with five different species of felines by gesture and teach them different tricks. Thirty or so fun activities are also available, as well as tons of accessories to personalise your little protégés.

metadata.title: Kinectimals - Now with Bears!
metadata.description: Your family gets bigger in this extended release of Kinectimals. Joining the original feline cubs, now play with cuddly bear cubs as you solve a new mystery on an undiscovered island! Share exciting adventures and fun challenges as you teach your best friends new tricks using your voice and body to interact naturally with them*. Explore lush islands and collect treasures and accessories for your cubs. Enjoy new interactions and activities. Embark on a journey of discovery and build a bond that grows every time you play.

metadata.title: King of Fighters XII, The (World)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: The King of Fighers XII is a fighting game for Xbox 360 that takes the series to a new level in terms of realisation. Entirely in 2D, the characters and scenery are this time handmade and displayed in high resolution.

A. Salvatore. Brought to life visually through the trademark visceral style of renowned artist and Spawn creator Todd McFarlane, Reckoning brings a new level of intense action combat to the RPG genre.

metadata.title: Knights Contract (Europe)
metadata.description: Knights Contract is a beat'em all for Xbox 360. You play as Heinrich, an invulnerable hero, who must constantly watch Gretchen, the witch who accompanies him. Knights Contract allows you to use both Heinrich's scythe and Gretchen's magical powers. Try to take advantage of your companion by giving her instructions and don't leave her in a bad situation to avoid game over.

metadata.description: Kung-Fu High Impact is an action game for Xbox 360 available for download. It requires Kinect to work. Indeed, the console's camera scans the player and integrates him directly into the game. The player has to really wiggle his arms and legs to hit his opponents.

Players must investigate crime scenes for clues, follow up leads, and interrogate suspects, and the players' success at these activities will impact how much of the cases' stories are revealed.

metadata.title: Tomb Raider : Anniversary (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Tomb Raider: Anniversary is an action and platform game for Xbox 360 that takes the very first episode of Lara Croft's adventures and gives it a new lease of life, both in terms of graphics and gameplay. Rediscover Peru, Greece or Egypt, alongside the pretty brunette hired by the firm Natla Technologies, to get her hands on fragments of an ancient relic called the Scion.

metadata.title: Tomb Raider Legend (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)

Lara Croft is on a quest to find one of the world's most precious treasures, a weapon that can bring peace to the world but also bring about its downfall. Avoid traps along the way, fight enemies vying for the same loot and use her acrobatic skills to get through.

It is in this context of war that the sister of young Rush is kidnapped. What follows is an epic quest to find these artifacts of power, to discover who wants to take over the world.

metadata.title: Left 4 Dead (Japan)
metadata.description: Left 4 Dead on Xbox 360 is a horrific FPS based largely on cooperation. Indeed, you play as one character in a group of four, but the other three can be led by friends. Escape the zombies by looking out for each other. To make things even more exciting, the game allows four other players to play as the undead and roam the city hunting down the heroes.

metadata.title: Left 4 Dead 2 (Germany)
metadata.description:
Battle the infected again in the sequel to Valve's original hit.
View larger.

Left 4 Dead 2 is set at roughly the same time as the original ? just after the outbreak that turned most of the population into various zombie mutants. Players assume the role of four new "Survivors," each with their own personality and new dialog. The game leads these "Survivors" through the southeastern region of the US - from Savannah, Georgia through the bayou country, and climaxing in New Orleans? French Quarter.

As evil spreads over the world, Spyro and Cynder must discover new abilities and unlock their true powers to defeat Malefor and stop him from destroying the world.

metadata.description: La Boîte de Pandore fut ouverte en des temps oubliés pour répandre sur l'humanité tous les maux de la création. Et voilà que vous vous apprêtez à l'ouvrir de nouveau dans Legendary sur Xbox 360, libérant cette fois une tripotée de monstres mythologiques. A vous de les chasser à travers New York et Londres pour les renfermer dans une nouvelle boîte, en espérant que personne ne viendra y toucher cette fois.

metadata.title: LEGO Batman : The Videogame (World)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Da)
metadata.description: When all the villains in Arkham Asylum team up and break loose, only the dynamic duo is bold enough to take them on to save Gotham City. The fun of LEGO, the drama of Batman and the uniqueness of the combination makes for a comical and exciting adventure in LEGO Batman: The Videogame. Play as Batman and his sidekick Robin as you build, drive, swing and fight your way through Gotham City capturing escaped villains including The Joker, Penguin, Scarecrow and more. Then, jump into the story from the other side and play as Batmans foes! Enjoy the power you wield and battle Batman while spreading chaos throughout the city. There is no rest for the good (or evil!).

metadata.title: LEGO Batman 2 : DC Super Heroes (USA)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl,Pt,Da,Pl,Ru)
metadata.description: LEGO Batman 2: DC Super Heroes is an action game and the sequel to LEGO Batman: The Videogame. Just like the first game it draws elements from the Batman universe but built entirely in LEGO-style bricks. It starts when a "Man of the Year" award ceremony in Gotham City is interrupted by the Joker and a gang of bandits. Bruce Wayne is a candidate for the award and changes into Batman to pursue them, teaming up with members of the Justice League.

metadata.title: LEGO Batman 3: Beyond Gotham (USA)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl,Pt,Da,Pl,Ru)
metadata.description: LEGO Batman 3: Beyond Gotham is the third LEGO game based on DC Comics characters. While it prominently features Batman and his supporting cast, as indicated by the subtitle it moves beyond Gotham City into all corners of the DC universe, featuring the Justice League, the Legion of Doom and several Lantern Corps, with all sorts of heroes and villains making an appearance, and the story moving from Earth to outer space and several other planets.

metadata.title: Lego Dimensions (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,Nl,Da)
metadata.description: LEGO Dimensions is a multi-franchise toys-to-life game featuring characters and levels from 14 licensed franchises with additional franchises due to arrive in the future. The game contains elements from the Middle Earth franchise, The LEGO Movie, DC Comics, The Wizard of Oz, The Simpsons, Back to the Future, Scooby-Doo, Doctor Who, Portal 2, the Midway Arcade franchise, LEGO Legends of Chima, LEGO Ninjago, Ghostbusters, and Jurassic World.

metadata.title: Lego Harry Potter: Years 1-4 (USA)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Da)(Rev 1)
metadata.description: Build the adventure from Privet Drive to the Triwizard Tournament and experience the magic of the first four Harry Potter stories – LEGO style! Explore Hogwarts™ School of Witchcraft and Wizardry, learn spells, brew potions and relive the adventures like never before with tongue-in-cheek humor and creative customization that is unique to LEGO videogames!

metadata.title: Lego Harry Potter: Years 5–7 (Russia)(En,Pl,Ru)
metadata.description: Lego Harry Potter: Years 5 to 7 on Xbox 360 is an action/adventure game that lets you relive the adventures of the young wizard Harry Potter. Swing various spells to progress through the scenario of the last three films and collect a host of bonuses of all kinds, both in solo and in cooperation.

metadata.description: LEGO Indiana Jones verbindet den Spiel- und Bauspaß von LEGO mit dem Humor, der Spannung und der rasanten Action der legendären Kinofilme, die Zuschauern auf der ganzen Welt den Atem raubten. Mit humorvoller Darstellung seiner größten Abenteuer verfolgst du Indiana Jones Eskapaden durch den südamerikanischen Dschungel bis zu den Berggipfeln Indiens. Fans können LEGO bauen, Kämpfe austragen und sich durch ihre Lieblings-Filmszenen schlagen, von Indys Begegnung mit Schlangen bis zu seiner überstürzten Flucht vor einer gewaltigen Felskugel. Gehe auf ein packendes, witziges Abenteuer voller Action!

Play as the most powerful Super Heroes in their quest to save the world.

metadata.description: LEGO Marvel, Super Heroes features an original story crossing the entire Marvel Universe. metadata.title: Lego Rock Band (USA)
metadata.description:
LEGO Rock Band is a blending of Rock Band and LEGO series. Players get to start a band and hire band members who will play with them. Just like with real Lego, players can mix and match bodies, torsos, legs and heads to create a character any way they want.

The main game has players touring around the world at various locations, like the original Rock Band games. Unlike Rock Band however, LEGO Rock Band also has special levels where you must perform outrageous tasks such as fighting an octopus or demolishing a building using your rock concert. As players make their way through the song lists, they earn "Studs", the game s currency. Studs can be used to purchase Lego items to decorate your Rock Den, hire new staff, buy new clothes or instruments.

The game will also feature exclusive playable content that bridges the story gap between Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi and Star Wars: The Force Awakens. LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens also introduces Multi-Builds and Blaster Battles to the LEGO videogame universe. metadata.description: Lightning Returns : Final Fantasy XIII est un jeu de rôle sur Xbox 360. On y retrouve l'héroïne Lightning après 500 ans de sommeil dans un monde approchant de l'apocalypse. Elle doit sauver des âmes pour repousser l'échéance en répondant à leurs demandes. Le titre propose un système de combat dynamique dans lequel on peut permuter entre trois styles instantanément.

metadata.title: Lips (Australia)
metadata.description: Lips est un karaoké sur Xbox 360 qui s'accompagne de microphones sans fil. Une grande quantité de chansons est disponible, mais rien n'empêche le joueur d'ajouter sa collection personnelle et d'en télécharger de nouvelles en ligne. Jusqu'à deux personnes peuvent chanter simultanément.

metadata.title: Lips - Deutsche Partyknaller
metadata.description: Lips: Deutsche Partyknaller is a localized version of Lips: Number One Hits for German-speaking countries. It was released in Germany, Austria and Belgium. The game itself is identical to Number One Hits, but the track list consists largely of German songs. Downloadable content from other Lips games can be carried over and songs can be imported by swapping the discs. The disc comes with 40 songs:* 2raumwohnung - Besser Geht's Nicht

metadata.title: Lips : I Love the 80s (Europe)
metadata.description: Lips : I Love the 80s est un karaoké Xbox 360 consacré, comme son nom l'indique, aux plus grands tubes des années 80. La tracklist rassemble aussi bien David Bowie que Kool & the Gang, The Police, The Communards ou encore Duran Duran.

metadata.title: Lips : Number One Hits (Europe)
metadata.description: Lips, karaoké sorti en 2008 sur Xbox 360, revient dans cette extension baptisée Number One Hits. Comme son nom l'indique, celle-ci vous permet de reprendre seul ou à plusieurs les plus grands hits de l'année 2009 : on y retrouve par exemple Tokyo Hotel, Rihanna, Coldplay ou encore Timbaland.

metadata.title: Lips : Party Classics (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl,Sv,No,Da,Fi,Zh,Pl,Ru)
metadata.description: Lips : Party Classics sur Xbox 360 est un jeu de karaoké proposant de chanter sur 40 morceaux connus de tous. Au menu : YMCA des Village People, I Will Survive de Gloria Gaynor, Wanabee des Spice Girls et bien d'autres !

metadata.title: LMA Manager 2007
metadata.description:
LMA Manager 2007 is a soccer management game in the LMA Manager series. Like its predecessors, the game allows players to manage a soccer team. Included are teams from over 50 different countries and leagues from 8 of those countries. Available are over a 1000 different officially licensed teams. The game features an improved database engine and a transfer system with more depth than its predecessors.

All matches can be watched in full 3D. The AI plays the matches out, but it is still possible to make adjustments to player positions and the like. It is also possible to see the results of matches and all kinds of player and team statistics in the ingame magazine "FootballOne".

metadata.title: Lollipop Chainsaw (Japan)(Premium Edition)
metadata.description: The game follows the adventures of Juliet Starling, a San Romero High School cheerleader who got caught in a zombie outbreak led by a Goth student and five zombie overlords representing types of music; Equipped with a chainsaw, Juliet must use her cheerleading abilities and charm to survive.

metadata.title: Looney Tunes : Acme Arsenal (Europe)
metadata.description: Looney Tunes: Acme Arsenal is an action-adventure game featuring seven playable Looney Tunes characters, including Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Tazmanian Devil, Foghorn Leghorn, Marvin the Martian, Gossamer and a special secret character, all rendered in high-definition, next-generation graphics. Engaging in one or two player cooperative gameplay, gamers find themselves immersed in fast-paced combat, puzzle solving challenges and vehicle-based action in rich environments inspired by the popular, outlandish cartoon tales. Players command an arsenal of ACME melee and projectile weapons in outrageous battles and travel to various locations such as Camelot, Ancient Egypt, Mars, the Wild West, the trenches of World War II and more. The Xbox 360 version allows players to fully utilize real-time physics and animation blending and Xbox Live online entertainment network will allow for two player cooperative game play.

metadata.title: Lost Odyssey (Europe, Asia)(Disc 1)
metadata.description: Lost Odyssey is the story of Kaim, an immortal character who has lived more than 1,000 years. He doesn't remember his past, and he doesn't know where his future lies. Throughout Kaim's journey, a handful of characters join him on an odyssey to discover their intricate past and destiny, leading players through a dramatic story of massive scale. Massively multiplayer online role-playing game elements are blended into the game's traditional role-playing game system, enabling players to make strategic decisions for a more immersive and deep gameplay experience. With story sequences penned by award-winning Japanese novelist Kiyoshi Shigematsu in cooperation with producer Hironobu Sakaguchi, Lost Odyssey sets a new benchmark for the RPG genre with a combination of true-to-life cinematics and an intriguing story of an immortal man. Players will witness Kaim's life as he lives through many generations, becomes part of numerous families, falls in and out of love, and confronts all of the conflicts that arise. Kaim's struggles are set in a world that is on the verge of a "mystical industrial revolution," where mankind has attained dark powers. The massively scoped worlds, memorable characters and epic storyline play as an intense and unsettling blockbuster action film. Heading up the artistic demands of the title is famed Japanese comic artist Takehiko Inoue. Renowned composer Nobuo Uematsu has been recruited to create a contemporary soundtrack.

metadata.title: Mass Effect (Canada)
metadata.description: Mass Effect is set in the year 2183 AD. Thirty-five years prior, humankind discovered a cache of technology on Mars, supposedly built by a technologically advanced but long-extinct race called the Protheans. Studying and adapting this technology, humanity has managed to break free of the solar system and has established numerous colonies and encountered various extraterrestrial species within the Milky Way galaxy. Utilizing alien artifacts known as Mass Relays, the various space-faring races are able to travel instantly across vast stretches of the galaxy. Within the game, humanity has formed the Human Systems Alliance, one of many independent bodies that make up the collective of "Citadel space". The Human Systems Alliance is a rising power in the galactic stage. The only war they have participated in was the "First Contact War" in 2157. A human exploration expedition was activating dormant mass relays (which was a practice considered unsafe by citadel races). The turians attacked the small fleet and proceeded to capture the closest human world, Shanxi. The turians proceeded to starve out the remaining humans and occupy the planet. Facing starvation the human garrison surrendered to the Turian Hierarchy. One month later, the human Second Fleet responded by annihilating the turian fleet around Shanxi. In response the turians prepared for full scale war. The citadel council saw that humanity would either be annihilated or annexed by the turians and stepped in. The humans were then given an embassy in the Citadel Council. Citadel space, as a whole, is ruled by a body of government known as the Council, which is made up of members of the three prominent alien races: the asari, a race of mono-gendered aliens which closely resemble blue-skinned human females; the short-lived salarians; and the raptor-like turians.

metadata.title: Mass Effect 2 (Canada)(Disque 1)
metadata.description: After the events of the original game, Commander Shepard is killed in an ambush by a mysterious alien species called the Collectors. Shepard is revived two years after the attack by an enigmatic organization called Cerberus, and is tasked with finding out more about the Collectors and why they are abducting entire human colonies. Shepard must build a team in order to accomplish what seems to be a suicide mission.

metadata.title: Mass Effect 3 (France)(Disc 1)
metadata.description:
Mass Effect 3 marks the final chapter in the Mass Effect trilogy, completing the story of Commander Shepard and the crew of the Normandy.

"Across the galaxy, entire human colonies are vanishing. As Commander Shepard, you will recruit an elite team of the galaxy?s most dangerous and skilled experts, and lead them on an assault into the most dangerous area of the galaxy - from which you might not return. Download new equipment and missions to continue your adventure even after the main story is complete. They say the mission is suicide. Prove them wrong."

metadata.description: Max Payne 3 is the third installment in Rockstar Games Max Payne series and is set eight years after the events of the last installment. No longer a cop, Max is close to washed-up, drunk and addicted to painkillers. Without a job on the force, Max has left the greater New York area, and finds himself in Sao Paulo, Brazil, working as private security. The story of Max's descent from vengeful, leather-jacket wearing detective roaming the alleys of New York to the broken, shaven-headed man out for justice on unfamiliar streets far from home is at the center of Max Payne 3. In addition to Max's classic shoot-dodge moves, there is now a combination of Natural Motion's Euphoria character behavior system and Bullet Time to enhance his moves. Partners and sidekicks will play a large role in this game to help Max in his quest for vengeance.

metadata.title: Medal of Honor : Warfighter (Europe)(En,De,It)(Disc 1)

They are members of the U.S. Navy SEALs and what starts out as a simple demolition job goes horribly wrong when the truck containing the explosive substance PETN blows up the docks almost completely. After Dusty's debriefing, also back from the previous game, Voodoo is assigned to Task Force Mako, along with DEVGRU agent Stump, while Mother and Preacher return to the scene to investigate the shipyard incident. Instead of one big battle, the game features missions linked together by the story of the search for the origin of the PETN substance.

metadata.title: Metro 2033 (Europe)(En,De)
metadata.description: Set in the shattered subway of a post apocalyptic Moscow, Metro 2033 is a story of intensive underground survival where the fate of mankind rests in your hands. In 2013 the world was devastated by an apocalyptic event, annihilating almost all mankind and turning the earth's surface into a poisonous wasteland. A handful of survivors took refuge in the depths of the Moscow underground, and human civilization entered a new Dark Age. The year is 2033. An entire generation has been born and raised underground, and their besieged Metro Station-Cities struggle for survival, with each other, and the mutant horrors that await outside. You are Artyom, born in the last days before the fire, but raised Underground. Having never ventured beyond your Metro Station-City limits, one fateful event sparks a desperate mission to the heart of the Metro system, to warn the remnants of mankind of a terrible impending threat. Your journey takes you from the forgotten catacombs beneath the subway to the desolate wastelands above, where your actions will determine the fate of mankind.

But be aware, there's something strange going on at Monster High! Cleo's new amulet has been cursed by the spirit of Spookenhamen, and the student body is falling under his spell. Use your skills and savvy to help save the school and all your new classmates from the mummy's curse! Be Yourself. Be Unique. Be a Monster.

metadata.title: Monster Hunter Frontier Online (Japan)
metadata.description: Monster Hunter Frontier Online for Xbox 360 is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game. In the tradition of the previous Monster Hunter series, you go on a monster hunt. The game features an action-based linear mode, and a multiplayer mode that allows you to hunt monsters in groups. Capcom has also set up a ranking of the best hunters.

metadata.title: Monster Jam (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Monster Jam sur Xbox 360 vous installe au volant des engins les plus ravageurs qui soient après la moissonneuse batteuse : les monster trucks. Faites vrombir le moteur de ces engins massifs et défiez vos concurrents en écrasant tout sur votre passage afin de monter sur la première marche du podium. Que ce soit dans des stades, à l'extérieur ou en compétition freestyle, bataillez dur pour devenir le champion du monde.

metadata.title: Monster Jam : Path of Destruction (USA)
metadata.description: Monster Jam: Path of Destruction on Xbox 360 is a truck game in which the player can choose from 28 different vehicles, but can also create and customise their own. Eight authentic stages pit the trucks (Grave Digger, Maximum Destruction and Grinder) against each other in both single and multiplayer modes.

metadata.title: Monster Madness : Battle for Suburbia (USA)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Monster Madness : Battle for Suburbia est un jeu d'action sur Xbox 360. Dans la peau de jeunes ados américains qui découvrent avec surprise des hordes de zombies devant chez eux, vous incarnez au choix quatre personnages : la bimbo, le skater, la gothique et l'intello de service dans les vingt niveaux disponibles. Le design complètement barré et déjanté confère au jeu une ambiance très particulière.

metadata.title: Morphx (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: MorphX is a third-person action game for Xbox 360 that takes us to Moscow in 2012, when the Earth is in the grip of an alien invasion. As a soldier infected by the aliens, you must try to survive by any means necessary, using your arsenal and the powers conferred by your hybrid condition: natural night vision, regenerative hand-to-hand attack, protective shield and others.

metadata.title: Mortal Kombat - Komplete Edition (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt)
metadata.description: Following the events of Mortal Kombat: Armageddon, both the forces of light and darkness have been wiped out, with only the thunder god Raiden and the Outworld emperor Shao Kahn remaining to represent their parties. A severely weakened Raiden is about to be killed by Shao Kahn, but casts a last-minute spell on the shattered pieces of his magical amulet, directing it to contact his past self with the vague message "He must win".

metadata.title: Mortal Kombat - Komplete Edition (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt)
metadata.description: Following the events of Mortal Kombat: Armageddon, both the forces of light and darkness have been wiped out, with only the thunder god Raiden and the Outworld emperor Shao Kahn remaining to represent their parties. A severely weakened Raiden is about to be killed by Shao Kahn, but casts a last-minute spell on the shattered pieces of his magical amulet, directing it to contact his past self with the vague message "He must win".

metadata.title: Mortal Kombat Vs Dc Universe (World)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description:
With the simultaneous defeat of Darkseid and Shao Kahn in their respective universes, a freak portal accident has formed the creation of a new entity that is more evil and more powerful entity that embodies the worst of both worlds: Dark Kahn.

Dark Kahn seeks to merge the DC universe and Mortal Kombat universe into one reality, forcing hero and villain alike to form unlikely alliances in order to keep their realities separate before they are consumed by "The Rage", a force that causes an individual to lose their minds and be consumed by their aggression.

In this arcade-style fighting game, both DC and Mortal Kombat universes are represented by 10 champions each, and one "boss" character, for a total of 22 fighters. Play is similar to the 2D Mortal Kombat games (with some 3D elements), focusing more on the special move aspect than the complex combos found in the previous three games (Deadly Alliance, Deception, Armageddon).

In addition, there are new modes of fighting found with in the gameplay: Klose Kombat, Freefall Kombat, and "Test Your Might", which use the environment as a mini-game style scenario to inflict stylized and extensive damage on an opponent, as well as "Rage", which turns standard moves into a devastating opportunity to crush your opponent. Players battle through such locales as Gotham City, Metropolis, the Shaolin Temples, or Earthrealm's Hell.

As with any Mortal Kombat game, Fatalities are still present for the Kombatants and villains, though slightly toned down to meet the DC standards of heroes such as Superman and Batman keeping to their moral code and not killing their opponent. As a result, the DC heroes perform "Heroic Brutalities", which effectively put their opponent out of commission.

Online play is also available for players to take their fights online for ranked matches, play against a friend, or another online opponent in tournaments.

metadata.title: Motionsports Adrenaline (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: Motionsports Adrenaline is an extreme sports game for Xbox 360. Travel around the world and challenge your friends in multiplayer on six thrilling events: Wingsuiting, kayaking, kitesurfing, mountain biking, climbing and extreme skiing. The software is compatible with Kinect.

metadata.title: Motogp '06 (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description:
MotoGP 06 is the 2006 installment of THQ's motorcycle racing series, having all the season data accurate for the year.

Gameplay is of similar type to its predecessors, being very tight controls with gameplay that relies heavily on skill and not known for its forgivingness. The game includes 17 GP tracks as well as 17 faster, less technical (and also fictional) "Extreme" tracks. Some of the modes available are typical racing types, with Career, Stunt and Practice being a few.

The updates to the game in this particular case are refined controls, updated graphics to bring the game up to par with the capabilities of the 360, new bikes and racers and quite importantly a heavily re-worked and refined Live play mode, which supports up to 16 players in a race on either the "GP" or "Extreme" tracks.

metadata.title: Motogp '07 (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: MotoGP '07 for Xbox 360 is, as the name suggests, a motorbike racing simulation. Join the real 850cc riders from 2007 and race on all the championship tracks. Experience a full extreme mode with 17 recreated and expanded tracks to take advantage of the 20 new customisable bikes. Compete against 15 other players online in new game modes and tournaments. You can even put your bike on the line to win someone else's!

metadata.title: Motogp 08 (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: MotoGP 08 is a racing game for Xbox 360 featuring the official 2008 season vehicles, riders and tracks. Three categories of motorbikes are available (125cc, 250cc and MotoGP) and three levels of realism (arcade, intermediate and simulation). The artificial intelligence of the competitors adapts to the player's level.

metadata.title: Motogp 10/11 (Europe)
metadata.description: MotoGP 10/11 is a motorbike racing game for Xbox 360. You play with all the bikes and riders of the 2010 championship on all tracks. The career mode allows you to participate in a championship by creating your own rider and changing category (from 125 to MotoGP). You can also have a partner join you in split screen mode. MotoGP 10/11 also features a multiplayer mode capable of hosting 20 participants.

metadata.title: Motogp 13 (Europe)
metadata.description: MotoGP 13 is a racing game for Xbox 360 with official World Championship licenses. The player can experience the career of a rider from Moto3 to MotoGP. Split-screen play and 12-player online battles complete the picture.

metadata.title: Motogp 14 (Europe)
metadata.description: MotoGP 14 is a racing game for 360. The player can experience the career of a motorbike racer, from the Moto3 class to MotoGP. They can also play as legendary riders such as Mick Doohan or complete certain challenges inspired by highlights of the 2013 season.

metadata.title: Motogp 15 (Europe)
metadata.description: MotoGP 15 is a racing game specialising in motorbikes, with a multitude of circuits and vehicle models. The major championships are obviously represented and the famous manufacturers are well present.

metadata.title: Motorcycle Club (Europe)
metadata.description: Motorbike Club is a motorbike racing game for Xbox 360. The player has access to around twenty official models as well as a customisable avatar. They can then race alone or with others on more than 20 tracks.

metadata.title: MTV Pimp My Ride (Europe)
metadata.description: A videogame adaptation of the TV show presented by Xzibit, Pimp my Ride on Xbox 360 invites players to transform dilapidated cars into rolling palaces. To do this, you must first accumulate funds by roaming the streets of Pimp City and playing various mini-games, then visit the various spare parts suppliers.

metadata.title: Mud - Fim Motocross World Championship (Europe)
metadata.description: MUD - FIM Motocross World Championship on Xbox 360 is a racing game. You can compete in the MX1 and MX2 world championships, but also in the motocross of nations. 84 real riders, 12 circuits and 6 freestyle arenas complete the picture.

metadata.title: Mushihime Sama Futari Ver 1.5 (Japan)
metadata.description: Mushihime Sama Futari Ver 1.5 is a shoot'em up for the Xbox 360. Developed by the Cave team, you will find the usual little ship, which will evolve on a vertical plane, confronted by countless enemy ships and other bosses of all kinds.

metadata.title: Musou Orochi
metadata.description: Musou Orochi Z, is a 2009 hack and slash video game developed by Koei and Omega Force for the Sony PlayStation 3 and Microsoft Windows. Z is the third installment of the Warriors Orochi series, a crossover video game of the Dynasty Warriors and Samurai Warriors series. Musou Orochi Z was intended to be a combination of the first two games with more characters and stages on an updated gaming platform. The game was released in Japan for PlayStation 3 on March 12, 2009 and released on Microsoft Windows platform on November 27, 2009. Koei had planned to release the game as Warriors Orochi Z in North America and Europe, but those plans have since been cancelled.

metadata.title: Musou Orochi - Maou Sairin
metadata.description: Warriors Orochi 2 is a 2008 video game developed by Koei (now Tecmo Koei) and Omega Force for the PlayStation 2. It is the sequel to Warriors Orochi, a crossover video game of the Dynasty Warriors and Samurai Warriors series. The game was released on September 23 in North America and September 19 in Europe. A version for the Xbox 360 was released on September 4, 2008 in Japan, and alongside the PS2 releases in North America and Europe. A PlayStation Portable version has been released in Japan, North America and Europe.

metadata.title: Musou Orochi 2
metadata.description: Warriors Orochi 3 Ultimate is an enhanced version of the hit action game Warriors Orochi 3, once again combining the much loved heroes of the Dynasty Warriors and Samurai Warriors series. The mythology of the Orochi universe expands with a new main storyline, which brings the heroes together again into the chaos of battle as they are summoned upon by a mysterious stone. The adventure is complemented by side stories offering over 175 scenarios and endings to uncover, including the ability to battle from the point of view of various characters and even "what if" hypothetical stages that exist in a parallel world.

metadata.title: Muv-Luv
metadata.description: Muv-Luv is a Japanese visual novel originally released as an adult game and the first game in the Muv-Luv franchise. Subsequent releases of the games were with the adult content removed. The game consists of two parts: Muv-Luv Extra and Muv-Luv Unlimited, which is unlocked after completing the two main heroine routes in Extra. The gameplay in Muv-Luv follows a linear plot line, which offers pre-determined scenarios and courses of interaction, and focuses on the differing scenarios of the female main characters. In 2015, the game, alongside Muv-Luv Alternative, photonflowers*, and photonmelodies♮, was fully funded for an English release on Kickstarter, for Windows PC via Steam, PlayStation Vita, and mobile platforms.

metadata.title: Muv-Luv Alternative
metadata.description:
"A destiny tossed about, in an insane world---
A flame of life blazing forth, in a dying world---
And now, one more future that is spun---

This is the alternative ending unable to be told before:
A very great, a very tiny, a very precious...
Tale of love and courage."

Muv-Luv Alternative continues the story of Shirogane Takeru after the events of the original Muv-Luv. This is a tale of a love so deep it breaks all barriers; about courage in the face of adversity and overcoming hardships. Takeru encounters insurmountable odds while his entire world is turned upside down around him.

metadata.title: Muv-Luv Alternative - Total Eclipse
metadata.description: Muv-Luv Alternative: Total Eclipse is a side story in the Muv-Luv series of visual novels and takes place in the same universe as Muv-Luv Alternative. The story takes place at Alaska's Yukon base, test site 18, where first-class staff from all over the world regardless of country gather to work on new Tactical Surface Fighters. The main characters are engineers and pilots and it features many TSFs that failed to show up in Alternative.

metadata.title: Mx Vs Atv Alive (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: MX vs ATV Alive is a motocross game for Xbox 360. This time, you can gain experience during races or win equipment by driving the same vehicles. There is a single player mode but also multiplayer content.

metadata.title: MX vs. ATV Supercross (USA)
metadata.description: MX vs ATV Supercross is a racing game available on Xbox 360. On a motorbike or a quad, the player must take part in races spread across the 4 corners of the United States. He can unlock new parts for his machine but also decoration elements for his pilot.

metadata.title: MX vs. ATV Untamed (USA)(Demo)
metadata.description: MX vs ATV Alive is a motocross game for Xbox 360. This time, you can gain experience during races or win equipment by driving the same vehicles. There is a single player mode but also multiplayer content.

metadata.title: MXGP : The Official Motocross Videogame (Europe)
metadata.description: MXGP: The Official Motocross Videogame is a racing game available on Xbox 360. The player can experience the career of a professional motocross rider from the MX2 class to MX1. The official riders, teams and circuits of the 2013 season have been modelled for the occasion.

metadata.title: My Horse & Me 2
metadata.description: Packed with exciting new features, brand new graphics and animations, and an engrossing storyline, horse sports fans will be treated to the most complete equestrian experience and the most realistic horse simulation ever seen in a game. My Horse and Me: Riding for Gold will let players live the ultimate bond between them and their horse. The My Horse and Me series boasts the exclusive worldwide license from the Fédération Equestre Internationale (FEI), the world's leading horse sports organization.

metadata.title: Mysims Skyheroes (USA)
metadata.description: In the action game MySims SkyHeroes on Xbox 360, players must fight against the infamous Morcubus who is trying to take over the skies. The title sends us into battle in the skies aboard various aircraft. In addition to its single player mode, the game offers local and online multiplayer.

metadata.title: N3 : Ninety-Nine Nights (Japan)(Demo)
metadata.description: N3: Ninety-Nine Nights on Xbox 360 is an action game in which your hero (or heroine, as the case may be) is confronted with a mass of enemies that you have to send flying in packs of 12 or more. Seven characters are available, each with their own characteristics. It's up to you to jump into the fray to discover the history of the protagonists and unlock some bonuses such as artworks.

metadata.title: Nail'd (Japan)
metadata.description:
In nail'd, the player takes the place of the driver participating in the off-road racing tournament. The only vehicles allowed are ATV (All Terrain Vehicle aka quad bike) and MTX (motocross bike).

The events are led at breakneck tracks in settings like Greece or Yosemite National Park. Unlike ones from another racing games, they are built from extreme turns (imagine 70 degree downhill and then three-way crossroad, leading to a hairpin turn), trampoline jumps hundreds of meters high and wide variety of ways to ride through.

In order to fit such hazardous environment, player has to upgrade his vehicle by installing better spare parts, unlocked after winning certain leagues. Each league consist of numerous events, either basic races or stunts challenges, where winner is decided by amount of points received by performing tricks (like perfect landing, jumping through rings in air and destroying opponents). Sometimes, so-called "mutators" are turned on, for example unlimited nitro.

metadata.title: Namco Museum : Virtual Arcade (Europe)
metadata.description: Namco Museum: Virtual Arcade on Xbox 360 features over 30 retro arcade games including: Ms. Pac-Man, Galaga, Dig Dug, Pac-Man Championship Edition, Mr. Driller Online and Galaga Legions. High scores are posted online. New versions of these classic games are also included.

metadata.title: Naruto : Rise of a Ninja (USA, Europe)
metadata.description: Join Konoha's most mischievous ninja apprentice in Naruto: Rise of a Ninja for Xbox 360. Roam the village in search of missions, forge your ninja and meet all the characters from Masashi Kishimoto's manga. Control your chakra to prevent the demon fox from leaving your body and become the next Hokage.

metadata.title: Naruto Shippuden : Ultimate Ninja Storm 2 (Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 2 is a fighting game for Xbox 360 that covers the entire Shippuden period of the original manga. A very complete Adventure mode allows you to relive the most impressive battles, staged in a striking way with lots of QTE. Playable online, the title features no less than 40 characters and benefits from a truly supercharged combat system.

metadata.title: Naruto Shippuden : Ultimate Ninja Storm 3 (Europe)
metadata.description: Narutimetto Sutōmu 3), the fourth installment of the UltimateStorm series, is a fighting game developed by CyberConnect2 as part of the Naruto: Ultimate Ninja video-game series based on Masashi Kishimoto's Naruto manga. It was released for PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 by Namco Bandai Games on March 5, 2013 in North America, March 8, 2013 in Europe, and April 18, 2013 in Japan.

metadata.title: Nascar ?14 (USA)
metadata.description:
NASCAR '14 is the fourth NASCAR racing game to be created by development studio Eutechnyx. The game features 23 different tracks available as "day time tracks" with extra night versions tracks for Atlanta, Bristol, Charlotte, Daytona, Kansas, Kentucky and Texas. The player has the ability to create custom paint schemes for their car which can then be used in both Career mode and online. The game features a highlight mode where the player replays a past real life race event and must meet various criteria. The highlight game modes use real life telemetry data from NASCAR to determine the location of every car on the track, as such they are similar to "on rails" events where AI cars will always follow the same paths.

The game contains 43 licensed drivers and has a season mode where it is possible to play through a whole season of racing as the driver of your choice.

metadata.title: Nascar 08 (Europe)
metadata.description: NASCAR 08 for Xbox 360, the direct sequel to NASCAR 07, is a next-gen racing game that allows you to control new cars, fully tune them, and the title also features an innovative new GPS system.

metadata.title: Nascar 09 (Europe)
metadata.description: Nascar 09 is a racing game for Xbox 360 in which you become a NASCAR driver, and you evolve - under the tutelage of the famous champion Jeff Gordon - with the aim of becoming number one. Choose the car that suits you best, customise it to your heart's content, and treat yourself to success and glory.

metadata.title: NASCAR 2011 - The Game
metadata.description:
Players can choose to play as themselves or as one of the sport's real-world drivers as they battle it out for the NASCAR Sprint Cup Series Championship. Each pro driver has the AI characteristics of his or her real world counterpart, setting the stage for intense rivalries played out on the track. Damage is meticulously detailed and multi-car wrecks are the most extreme ever experienced in an officially licensed racing game.

Winning has also never felt so good with the all new interactive celebration mode. Not only can you partake on your victory lap doing donuts and burnouts, but for the first time ever, jump out of your car and pump up the crowd, and even back flip off your car in the winner's circle. From the 22 real world tracks to full pit stop strategy action, NASCAR The Game 2011 captures the real atmosphere, sense of speed and spectacle that embodies NASCAR. The game also includes an in-depth multiplayer mode which allows for 16 players to battle it out for the win online.

metadata.title: Natgeo Quiz! Wild Life (Europe)
metadata.description: NatGeo Quiz Wild Life for Xbox 360 is a multiplayer quiz about nature and animals. Developed in collaboration with the National Geographic Society, the title features 5,000 questions, 90 minutes of high definition video and nearly 2,000 images.

metadata.title: National Geographic Challenge ! (USA)
metadata.description: National Geographic Challenge! is family entertainment for Xbox 360. In National Geographic Challenge! players explore the planet through its geography and history. Get ready for a journey through time on 5 continents that will immerse you in the amazing evolution of humanity.

metadata.title: Naughty Bear (USA)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Naughty Bear is a very special action/adventure game for Xbox 360. Taking place in a dreamlike world populated by charming teddy bears, the player embodies Naughty Bear, an outcast rejected by his fellow bears. Your objective: to take revenge on your fellow citizens by terrorising them or even killing them in a particularly cruel manner. You will also have to triumph over the bosses in each of the seven worlds of the game.

metadata.title: Naughty Bear - Gold Edition
metadata.description:
Naughty Bear is a third-person shooter action video game released in June 2010 for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 consoles. Players control the eponymous bear as they use various things to earn "nasty Points", with extra points being given for random missions.

The game is set on a paradisal island where teddy bears live in harmony. The main character, Naughty Bear, is a shabby teddy bear who has a tendency to be mischievous, which earns him the dislike of the other bears. Like the other teddy bears, he does not speak but instead conveys his emotions through a variety of sounds and facial expressions. His actions are influenced by an unseen narrator with a demeanor reminiscent of that of a young children's television show host.

metadata.title: Naval Assault : The Killing Tide (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: Naval Assault: The Killing Tide is a simulation game for Xbox 360 that puts you in the shoes of an American submarine captain during the Second World War. Your objective throughout the thirty or so missions offered will be to repel the Axis forces both underwater and on the surface.

metadata.title: Nba 2k10 (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description: NBA 2K10 is a basketball game for Xbox 360. The title features simulation-based gameplay for more real-world games. In the My Player mode, you guide your avatar from the depths of the basketball world to the top of the NBA. In addition, each player has his own specific animations and movements.

metadata.title: Nba 2k11 (World)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It)
metadata.description:
Relive 10 of the most memorable games of Michael Jordan's career. If you can replicate the scenarios from these 10 legendary games, you'll unlock the MJ: A Legend in Action game mode.

The most realistic dribbling system on the market has been further enhanced to give you more fluid dribbling patterns than ever before, allowing you to dominate opponents with the same ease and grace as Michael Jordan.

Discover the many facets of an NBA player's career, on and off the court.
and off the court. From press conferences to endorsements to transfer requests, there's more to your career than just a stat line.

With NBA Actu, not only can you follow the latest NBA news and stats while playing, but you'll also get a brand new halftime show for your games, plus new live commentary from the court, ...
